specs.material: Metal frame with removable plush mattress

record.description: A two-tier cat perch that attaches to a window with suction cups. The metal frame holds a removable plush mattress that can be machine washed. It supports up to 55 pounds and the spacing between levels is adjustable. Check your window width before buying, since narrow windows may not fit.

A black slip-on slipper for women from Merrell, sized US 5 medium. The outsole is designed to give durable traction on a range of surfaces. Its casual slip-on style makes it easy to put on and take off for everyday wear around the house.

A long buffalo plaid table runner in black and white, sized for banquet, dining or buffet tables that seat eight to ten. The cotton and polyester fabric can be machine washed on a gentle cycle and dried on low. Suitable for holidays, celebrations and everyday rustic decor.

A black linerlock knife from Case, listed under sporting goods. The package measures about 2.8 by 4.8 by 13 centimeters and weighs 0.14 kilograms. It was made in China. The listing gives no blade or handle details, so check the specifications before buying.

An indoor stationary exercise bike for cardio workouts at home. Its 30 pound flywheel is adjusted by hand to change resistance. The padded seat moves along two axes, and the handlebars can be set to suit arm length. A built-in bottle holder and a phone or accessory holder are included.

A lightweight camouflage backpack for elementary school children, in red camo. It has four compartments, two mesh side pockets for a water bottle, and an inner pouch for small items. Padded S-shaped straps and a top handle make it comfortable to carry. The material is water resistant and easy to wipe clean.

A pair of semi-sheer linen blend curtain panels in a dove colored solid weave. Each panel has eight nickel grommets and fits rods up to about 1.25 inches thick. The fabric filters light while keeping the room private. The panels can be machine washed in cold water and ironed when needed.

A single 0.4 fluid ounce bottle of nail polish in the Iris Illusion shade. The formula is marketed for strong wear and bold, glossy color. The listing does not include application steps, so review the packaging for directions before first use.

A black countertop rack that stores mugs and teacups by their handles. Its branches curve upward to hold cups of different sizes in place. The looped top makes it easy to move the rack between the counter and a coffee station. Wipe clean with a damp cloth and towel dry.

A men's jacket in the Shadow colorway, sized medium. The outer fabric is treated to repel water and has stretch for freedom of movement. Panels at the back and elbows are designed to reduce restriction when reaching or bending.

A collapsible laundry hamper with a 74 liter capacity and two removable bags, so one can be swapped out while the other is emptied. Four fiber rods keep the basket upright. The 600D Oxford fabric is meant to outlast non-woven alternatives. It folds flat for travel or small rooms.

A collectible prize figure of the Echidna character from the Re:Zero franchise, made by Taito. This version wears a Mandarin dress. The figure includes a base stand. It is an officially licensed product.

A women's black down jacket in size XL. It is filled with 700 fill power goose down and has a waterproof, breathable outer shell with four way stretch. The hood can be adjusted or removed, and the jacket has underarm vents, a zippered waist pocket and a drop tail hem.

Non-slip socks for infants and toddlers from newborn through 36 months. Rubber dots on the soles help little ones walk, crawl or play on slick floors. The combed cotton is breathable and stretchy, and the ankle elastic is loose to avoid pressure on delicate skin. Sold in packs of 6 or 12.

An unframed canvas print reproducing Edward Hopper's People in the Sun. The image is printed in high definition with inkjet technology on a glossy canvas. Suited to living rooms, bedrooms, offices and other interior spaces. Each panel is individually packed in a sturdy box to arrive safely.

specs.fit: Roomier shoulders and chest, tapered waist

record.description: A men's fitted dress shirt in solid grey poplin, sized 17.5 neck and 36 to 37 inch sleeve, X-Large. It has a point collar that works with or without a tie, and two cuff button positions for a custom fit. The shirt has a chest pocket and is designed to resist wrinkles.

A classic red steel wagon with a seamless body and undercarriage. Its 10 inch rubber tires give a smooth ride, and the long pull handle folds under for storage. Listed for children 1.5 years and older and for hauling garden supplies. The listing states two different weight limits, so confirm before loading it.

A wireless full coverage bra in Star White, size 38C. Lightly lined cups aim to provide support and modest coverage, and the silky fabric keeps a sleek look under clothing. Back straps convert between traditional and crisscross styles, with a hook and eye closure offering three adjustment settings.

specs.material: Wheat straw fiber and food grade PP

record.description: A set of four unbreakable bowls holding 24 ounces each, made from wheat straw fiber and food grade polypropylene. They are lightweight, have smooth rounded edges and are free of BPA. The bowls can go in the dishwasher and microwave and tolerate temperatures up to 120 degrees Celsius.

A single pre-assembled cake topper shaped like the number one for a first birthday. It is made of card stock with a sparkly blue glitter layer. The seller says the glitter leaves no residue on cake or hands. It also works as a prop for cake smash photos.

A metric flanged sleeve bearing made of self-lubricating sintered bronze, with a 12 mm bore and 15 mm outer diameter. The flange measures 18 mm across and 1.5 mm thick. These copper colored bearings resist wear and corrosion and suit general purpose uses at moderate speeds and loads.

specs.media: Sheets 8.3 to 24 in, rolls 11 to 24 in

record.description: A compact wireless plotter for architects, engineers and builders working from a home or small office. It prints up to 24 inches wide from sheets or rolls and includes an automatic cutter. It connects by Ethernet, USB or Wi-Fi and supports mobile printing through Android, Chrome OS and iOS.

A five pack of white sleeveless bodysuits for babies aged 6 to 12 months. The soft, flexible fabric moves with the baby and has four way stretch. Expandable shoulders make it easier to pull the garment over the head. Reinforced snaps are built to hold up over time.

A set of three stainless steel mixing bowls holding 1.5, 3 and 5 quarts. Built to commercial grade, they resist staining, odors and rust, and they nest to save space. The bowls are dishwasher safe and can go into the refrigerator or freezer for storage.

A women's short summer dress in burnt orange with an all-over print, sized XL. It has a V neckline, an A-line high waist and a non-stretch fabric. The dress can be machine or hand washed. Buyers are advised to review the size chart shown in the listing images before ordering.

A green lanyard with a cactus print for holding an ID badge and work keys. The soft polyester strap has a metal key clasp and a card holder for two cards. The strap is about 19 inches long and an inch wide. The seller offers a replacement or refund if there is a problem within 30 days.

A women's short-sleeved Halloween t-shirt with a letter print that reads I Smell Children and a Sanderson Sisters graphic. The cotton blend is soft and stretchy, and the loose fit has a round neckline. The seller recommends washing in normal temperature water to keep the print and color looking good.

A small bifold wallet for women in pink, made of embossed cowhide leather with a checkered pattern. It has RFID blocking material intended to guard cards against wireless scanning. Inside are nine card slots, a photo slot, a coin pocket and a bill compartment with a snap closure.

specs.closure: Roll to remove air, no vacuum

record.description: A set of eight roll-up travel storage bags, three large suitcase size and five medium carry-on size. Air is pushed out by rolling the bag, so no vacuum is needed. The seller says the bags help block bugs, moths, dirt, mildew and odors, and they suit coats and laundry.

A women's running shoe for moderate mileage in grape, silver and begonia pink, US size 6 medium. Gel cushioning in the heel and forefoot softens impact and eases the transition into midstance. The removable sockliner can be taken out to fit a medical orthotic.

A white three cube storage organizer with a sturdy frame and an open back. It is finished on both front and back, so it can stand in a room. Each cube fits 13 inch fabric storage bins, and the unit can be placed vertically or horizontally. All hardware is included for assembly.

A vintage style flap handbag in brown patent PU leather with a polyester lining. It has a magnetic snap plus a zipper, a top handle and a detachable metal chain strap that can be worn as a crossbody. The listing offers the bag in brown, grey and red.

specs.material: TPU bumper with matte PC back

record.description: A slim protective case for the iPhone XR in blue, with a matte back and a soft TPU bumper around the edges. The raised front lip helps protect the screen. Cutouts allow access to buttons and ports without removing the case, and the case supports wireless charging.

A short-sleeved black baby bodysuit with a novelty print of a 90s sitcom quote. It is made of pre-shrunk ring-spun cotton and has a snap crotch for easy changes. The inks, fibers, labels and fasteners are certified to OEKO-TEX Standard 100. Printed and shipped from Austin, Texas.

A women's western cowboy boot in a brown floral colorway, US size 11 medium. It has a Duratread outsole. The listing gives few other details, so check the product page for upper material and fit notes before ordering.

specs.fitment: 2016-2019 Nissan Titan and Titan XD, all cabs

record.description: Electric running boards for 2016 to 2019 Nissan Titan and Titan XD trucks in all cab styles. They extend when the door opens, retract when it closes, and include an LED light. The die-cast aluminum frame has a black coated finish and is rated for 600 pounds per side. Made in the USA.

An 18 inch box chain made of 925 sterling silver and plated with rhodium to resist tarnish and keep its shine. The links are 0.8 millimeters wide, a light weight suited to everyday wear. The lobster claw clasp is designed to be sturdy. The listing describes the chain as hypoallergenic and nickel free.

A jumbo pencil eraser shaped like a green shark, sold as a single piece for school, homework or office use. The listing positions it as a back to school gift. It is marketed for erasing large mistakes.

A women's short-sleeved midi dress with navy stripes, size large. It is made of 100 percent polyester with a stretch fabric that forms a curvy fit. The dress has a round neckline and a hidden back zipper. The listing advises buyers who fall between sizes to order the next size up.

A chrome aerator rated at 2.2 gallons per minute for Delta Neo Style lavatory faucets. It has a 55/64 inch by 27 female thread. The listing notes the item is made in China and directs buyers to Delta technical assistance for questions.

A men's slim fit button-up shirt in bright white, size medium. The linen and cotton blend is lightweight and breathable for warm weather. It has a narrow collar and rolled sleeves that suit business casual or weekend wear. The listing says it can go in the washer and dryer.
A men's lightweight V-neck t-shirt with a chest pocket, in pampas, size large. The slub jersey cotton is soft and fits close to the body for a slim look. It is sold under Amazon's own clothing brand.

A black rubber ramp mat, 3 by 4 feet and 1/8 inch thick, with a cleated surface that reduces slipping. It suits inclined paths, entryways, boat docks and temporary walkways. The textured surface can also protect subfloors in busy retail stores, hotels and apartments.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: A white cotton throw with a diamond pattern and decorative fringe, measuring 50 by 60 inches. It can warm a couch or chair, dress up a room, or serve as a picnic or camping blanket. Wash in cold water on a gentle cycle and tumble dry on low.

A 10 inch heavyweight aluminum pan for baking angel food cake. The nonstick coating helps cakes release and makes cleanup easier. The heavy aluminum distributes heat gently and evenly. Hand wash with a mild detergent. Made in the United States.

A clear slim case for the iPhone 11 Pro Max with a hard back and flexible silicone bumper. The corners are reinforced to resist drops, and the lip wraps around the camera and screen. The listing says the case is compatible with most wireless chargers and supports 15 watt charging.

A men's black oxford with a bike toe shape and blind eyelet lacing. The lining wicks moisture, and the ECCO comfort fibre system is intended to keep the feet ventilated. The single component polyurethane outsole includes a shock point for cushioning.

A pressure mounted steel baby gate with a walk through door. It expands to fit openings from 29 to 38 inches, or 42 to 47 inches with the extension kit, and stands 30 inches tall. Includes wall cups for added security and is certified to JPMA and ASTM standards. Measure the opening before buying.

A low-cut men's soccer shoe made for artificial turf, in core black with white and active red accents, US size 11.5. It has a regular fit and a 3D printed striking zone. The shoe is intended for players on synthetic pitches.

A triangular shade sail measuring 12 feet on each side, made of 185 GSM high density polyethylene in sand. It blocks up to 95 percent of UV rays while letting air and water pass through. Install it at a 20 to 40 degree angle for runoff. Ropes and stainless steel D-rings come included.

specs.care: Hand wash cold, do not bleach, hang dry

record.description: Flowy high-waisted wide-leg palazzo pants in a soft peach-skin blend. The high waistband is meant to stay put without digging in, and the flared legs give a long, slimming line.

Queen-size reversible comforter with two matching pillow shams. The brushed microfiber shell and polyester fill give lightweight warmth suited to all seasons. The reversible design offers two solid colors. Machine washable in cold water.

Adjustable LED headlamp with an 800-lumen bulb and three light modes: high, low and strobe, plus zoom. The head tilts 90 degrees and the elastic band adjusts for a secure fit. It is water resistant, but the battery cover is not waterproof.

A box of five lemon-vanilla wafer crisps with a sweet vanilla coating and a lemon filling. Each crisp supplies 11 grams of protein and 5 grams of fiber. Per serving, net carbs are 4 grams and sugar is 1 gram, which suits low-carb eating.

Mid-rise bootcut women's work jeans with a stretch cotton-and-Lycra blend for easy movement. The flame-resistant fabric is rated to NFPA 70E, NFPA 2112 and CAT 2 standards. Embroidered back pockets add style for hazardous job sites.

Slip-on women's house slippers with a plush fleece lining and a memory foam insole that cushions and holds shape. The rubber sole has grip for indoor and outdoor use. The wool-like upper can be machine washed.

Relaxed straight-fit carpenter jeans made from soft, garment-washed lightweight cotton duck. Features include a hammer loop, a coin pocket and triple-stitched seams. The roomy cut allows bending, stooping and kneeling for work.

Matching his-and-hers ring set with a round cubic zirconia engagement ring for women and a stainless steel comfort-fit band for men. The 316L stainless steel resists tarnish and is nickel free. A gift box is included.
Universal mount that lets binoculars lacking a tripod socket attach to a standard tripod. It uses a 1/4-20 screw thread, so it works with common tripod heads and stands.

specs.width: Wide widths in black and natural

record.description: Classic flip-flop style spa slipper made from plush terry with a memory foam footbed that supports the heel and arch. Its anti-skid rubber sole works indoors and outdoors. The open toe design suits spa visits, travel, gym and daily wear.

specs.features: Seamless toe, arch support, turn welt top

record.description: Moderate graduated compression socks rated 15-20 mmHg, designed for all-day wear, travel, long periods of standing and exercise. The yarn manages moisture, controls odor and regulates temperature. Seamless toe and arch support add comfort.

Loose-fitting women's tunic with a notch neckline and 3/4 roll-tab sleeves. The lightweight, stretchy blend of polyester and spandex has a high-low hem that drapes well over leggings or jeans. Sized from X-Small to 3X.

Adjustable black luggage strap that cinches bags for travel. Its rugged ABS buckle and polypropylene strap are built for rough baggage handling. It fits bags up to 72 inches and its distinct look makes luggage easier to spot.

Western-style ankle bootie with a pointed closed toe and a V cutout at the front. It has a low stacked heel, light padding and an inner zip for easy on and off. Made from man-made materials, it is vegan.
A set of 69 PVC stickers themed on the Futurama cartoon TV show. The stickers are roughly one to three inches and suit laptops, skateboards, luggage and bicycles.

Strappy women's sandals with a soft, light foam insole and a Croslite foam outsole for durable support. The flexible gore upper is designed to feel comfortable from the first wear. The fit is relaxed, so ordering a size up is suggested.

A humorous birthday card with modern lettering on a sunrise-themed cover and a laugh-out-loud message inside. It measures about 5 by 7 inches and includes a matching envelope. The paper comes from well-managed forests.

Flat women's shoes with a knit upper and a soft cotton-lined interior. The leather insole offers arch and ball cushioning, while the jelly outsole is flexible and slip resistant. The insole can be removed so the shoes can be machine washed.
Lightweight classic-fit graphic t-shirt with a Switzerland and Alps theme, suited to hiking, travel and gift-giving. It has double-needle stitching at the sleeves and hem for a sturdier finish.

Foil-backed cotton pipe wrap for heating and AC ducts. It insulates, cushions and reduces vibration, and carries a Class A fire rating. Installation is simple, and handling it does not call for gloves, a face mask or goggles.

Compact espresso and cappuccino machine with 1,350 watts of power and a 20-bar pump. A steam nozzle froths milk for cappuccinos and other hot drinks. The 1.3-quart water tank is removable, and the drip tray and nozzle detach for cleaning.
20-inch freestyle BMX bike with 48-spoke wheels, a freestyle rotor, front and rear U-brakes and pegs at both ends. It has a deluxe paint finish.

specs.dimensions: 41 x 17.25 x 12.5 inches (H x W x D)

record.description: Walnut jewelry armoire with a locking top lid, two side doors and eight pull-out drawers. Inside, the lid holds rings and a mirror, and the doors have double-tiered necklace hooks. Built from solid wood and veneer, it requires no assembly.

specs.included: Carry bag, repair kit, 5 stakes, 2 hoses

record.description: Inflatable water park with two slides, a climbing wall and a splash pool, plus a water cannon that keeps the slides wet. Built from puncture-resistant fabric with safety netting, it is recommended for ages 3 to 10. The blower is sold separately.

Wired three-button optical mouse with 1000 DPI tracking and a rainbow LED light. It is plug and play, requiring no drivers, and works with Windows and Mac computers. The cord measures 1.6 meters and the rubber scroll wheel makes scrolling easy.

Mid-calf winter boot with waterproof suede uppers and a soft shearling cuff. The vulcanized rubber shell and seam-sealed construction keep moisture out, while faux fur lining and a felt frost plug add warmth.

Classic faux mink individual lash extensions with a CC curl, 0.25 mm thickness and 8 mm length, sold for salon use. The strips use a metallic film backing rather than paper, which avoids leaving residue. Lengths run from 8 to 20 mm and thicknesses from 0.03 to 0.25 mm.

Two-pack of long-sleeve men's t-shirts in sport grey, made with a moisture-wicking blend. The shoulders are set lower with a longer drop, and the sleeves are wider and shorter. Spandex cuffs add stretch, and reinforced neck tape supports the collar.

Minimizer underwire bra with a 2-ply back and supportive fabric that smooths and shapes. It reduces projection by up to 1 1/2 inches. Straps are spaced wider and the underwire opens more for comfortable support, and the neckline has balanced coverage.

Folding 48-inch wedge mat with a 15.5-degree incline for tumbling, stretching, yoga and gymnastics practice. It is filled with high-density foam and has a zippered cover that can be removed and cleaned. Its trapezoid shape lets several mats stack for storage.

specs.closure: Hook and loop wings, bottom zipper

record.description: Swaddle sack for infants aged 0 to 3 months, sized for 7 to 14 pounds or up to 26 inches. Arms can go in, out or one of each, and the wings fasten with hook and loop. A bottom zipper allows diaper changes without unwrapping the baby.

Small pendant charm in the shape of the number 1, cut from 14k white gold and laser-etched. It measures about 14 by 4 millimeters, with a brushed finish and rhodium plating. Gift packaging and a certificate of authenticity are included.

Slim clear case for iPhone X and XS in white. It uses D3O impact protection and is drop tested to military standard, up to 10 feet. A scratch-resistant UV coating and beveled edges add protection, while cutouts keep buttons and ports accessible.

Women's winter ankle boots with a faux-leather upper, quilted side panels and a faux fur collar for warmth. The padded lining and rubber sole give traction on slippery surfaces. Vegan construction with synthetic materials.

Slim-fit bootcut men's jeans in black with five-pocket styling and a touch of stretch for comfort. They sit below the waist, are slim through the thigh and widen to a 17-inch leg opening at the ankle. Suited to everyday wear.

Women's Weekender watch with a reversible nylon slip-thru strap that is blue on one side and has a floral swirl print on the other. It has a round white dial, a 38 mm silver-tone case and an Indiglo light. It is water resistant to 30 meters, which covers splashes and brief immersion but not swimming.

Low-rise cargo-style scrub pants in black with a drawstring waistband and several pockets, one of them sized for scissors. A D-ring on the left leg and adjustable ankle toggles add function. Sized in XX-large petite.

One-piece swimsuit for young girls with a dog print, made from a stretchy polyamide and elastane blend. The fabric is smooth on sensitive skin and dries fairly quickly. It suits pool, beach, party and bath time, and should be hung to dry.
Officially licensed Marvel t-shirt with a Miles Morales climbing graphic from the Spider-Verse theme. Classic-fit, lightweight and finished with double-needle stitching at the sleeves and hem.

A set of ten temporary hair chalk combs for adding color that washes out with regular shampoo. It works best on light hair such as gray or blonde, and darker hair may need water first. Suitable for costumes, parties and kids aged 3 and up.

Three pairs of black no-show liners with a breathable mesh upper and a padded, airy sole. The ultra-low cut stays hidden in shoes, and a silicone heel grip helps keep them in place. The soft construction is sized 9 to 11.

A 5.2-channel home theater receiver rated at 140 watts per channel. It passes 4K Ultra HD video with HDR and HLG support, and includes built-in Bluetooth and a USB port. HEOS Link lets it join a multi-room audio system.

Foldable vocal booth and mic isolation shield with 2-inch egg-crate acoustic foam on all inside surfaces. It cuts reflections and room coloration, and it works on a table or with a mic stand. Setup takes minutes, and it folds down for travel.

Structured medium-profile cap in musk green with a washed cotton canvas front and polyester mesh back. It has a pre-curved, sandwich-style visor and a Carhartt patch on the front. The sweatband is designed to fight odor and wick sweat.

Black laser projector with built-in Android TV and a remote with voice search. It projects images up to 150 inches, even in a lit room, and streams apps such as Netflix and YouTube. A built-in speaker and a 3.5 mm stereo output provide sound.

Retro tennis-style women's sneaker with a leather upper and a contrasting Swoosh that runs from heel to midfoot. Traditional laces give a secure fit, and a rubber herringbone outsole provides traction. The soft fabric lining and comfort footbed add everyday comfort.

Black nylon organizer bag for cables, chargers, memory cards and small devices, with two zippers and a removable hand strap. Inside, elastic loops hold cables while mesh pockets and a pad suit a mini tablet. Its water-resistant case fits in a briefcase, luggage or backpack.

Women's tote in hushed turquoise with a large main compartment and a wordmark zipper pull. Its UA Storm finish is highly water-resistant, and double webbing straps allow several ways to carry it. At about 25 liters, it is roomy for everyday essentials.

Lightweight Nike shoe with a Flyknit upper that fits like a sock. Zoom Air cushioning sits underfoot, and a pull tab at the heel makes it easy to slip on. The rubber outsole is built to last. The design revives a model first released in the 1980s.

Magnetic fiberglass screen door sized for a 36-by-80-inch doorway, with a screen that measures 38 by 81 inches for overlap. Magnets hold it closed, and hook-and-loop hasps at the middle and bottom help it stay in place in wind. It lets in fresh air and sunlight.
A plush, shaggy rug in teal blue suited to bedrooms, living rooms, and kids' rooms. Its tall, soft pile feels cushy underfoot, and the dotted underside helps it resist sliding on smooth floors.

A long-sleeve henley-style popover in a soft blue, with a mandarin collar and buttons down the chest. The oxford-weave cotton blend is thick enough to stay opaque and hold its shape through repeated washing. Suits casual days, cooler seasons, and costume wear.

A practice putting mat with turf designed to feel like a real green. It includes two cups with flags, and its cushioned rubber underside makes standing on it more comfortable. Works in indoor or outdoor settings.

A manual-focus prime lens for compact mirrorless cameras with an EOS-M mount. Its wide F1.2 aperture gathers plenty of light for low-light shooting and shallow depth of field. The focus ring has a crescent shape, and the optics use a multi-layer coating.

A pair of battery-powered flameless candles with a frosted plastic shell and a moving flame effect. The sealed design resists rain, so they can stay outside. A remote and built-in timers let you switch them on and off from a distance.

A thermal base layer set with a long-sleeve top and long johns, made for cold-weather outdoor activities like hiking, skiing, and cycling. The stretchy fabric moves with the body, and the seamless build aims for comfort.

Replacement USB charging cord with a 2.0 mm DC plug for the Mini S530 wireless earbuds. Its 30 cm length works with a wall adapter, laptop port, or power bank. Measure the plug before ordering, since some devices need a different connector.

A fabric storage bin sized for cube shelves, with a handle tab on the front for easy pulling. The front carries a felt animal applique, and the bin suits toys and small kids' items in a nursery or playroom.

A soft insulated lunch tote with two compartments so food stays separated. Its PEVA-lined interior wipes clean and resists leaks, and the insulated layer keeps contents warm or cold. Works for work lunches, picnics, and beach trips.

A set of four stoneware rice bowls in a multicolor pattern, handmade in England. They hold up to the oven, the microwave, the freezer, and the dishwasher, which makes them practical for everyday meals and reheating.

A cardboard scratcher shaped like a lounge chair, with catnip mixed between each layer. Cats can scratch it, stretch out on it, or curl up for a rest. The corrugated texture imitates tree bark, a surface many cats naturally prefer.

specs.style: Sleeveless lace fit and flare midi

record.description: A sleeveless navy midi dress with a lace fit-and-flare silhouette and partial lining. The cut runs small, so shoppers who fall between sizes may want to size up.
A cherry blossom scented body wash that cleanses while leaving a light floral fragrance. Lather it on wet skin and rinse. Designed for sensitive skin, in one 8.4 ounce bottle.

A replacement oil filter, model 57502XP, from WIX. The package weighs about three quarters of a pound and measures roughly 3 by 3 by 5 inches. Made in China. Check the model number against your vehicle before installing.

A large nylon beach mat that fits four to eight adults and sheds sand easily. It has pockets for small belongings and four stakes to hold it in wind, and it folds into a compact bag for carrying. Good for picnics, camping, and yoga.

A casual boat-style sneaker for kids that looks dressy enough for occasions. It has a leather-look upper, a lace-up fit, and a memory foam footbed for cushioning. The rubber outsole provides traction on slick surfaces.
A short black boot with a soft suede upper and a rubber logo printed on the front of the shaft. Its UGGpure lining and insole add cushioning, and the Treadlite outsole keeps the sole light.

A pink waterproof apron made of smooth, glossy vinyl that wipes clean easily. Adjustable straps tie at the neck and waist, and a linen lining sits against the body for comfort. Useful for cooking, gardening, and garage work.

A full-motion wall bracket for flat and curved TVs and monitors in the 13 to 30 inch range. It tilts, swivels, and rotates, and its arm extends about 14 inches from the wall. Mounting hardware is included for walls of wood, concrete, or brick.

A three-tier corner shelf with fan-shaped boards hung from jute rope. The paulownia wood is light and has a torched dark brown finish. Each shelf holds up to about 10 pounds, and it only works when hung in a corner.

A set of coordinating cotton dresses for baby girls, sized for 12 to 18 months. The soft fabric is gentle on delicate skin and suits everyday wear. The blueberry print makes this an affordable value pack.

Absorbent training pads for dogs of all sizes, measuring 22 by 23 inches. The pads contain an attractant to draw dogs toward them during potty training, and a gel core locks in liquid. A Febreze fragrance is included to help combat ammonia odor.

A collapsible drying rack that mounts to the wall and folds flat when not in use. It holds several garments for air-drying or reducing wrinkles, and it works on drywall, brick, concrete, or wood. Mounting template and hardware are included.

specs.lettering: 2 in x 12 in black OVERSIZE LOAD

record.description: A mesh nylon oversize load banner in yellow with black lettering, meant to be fastened to the front or back of a vehicle or pilot car. Rust-resistant brass grommets and black edge binding help the sign last longer in the field.
A set of 48 floating golf balls in neon green for practicing on water or at a pool. Each ball has a two-piece design with 432 dimples and a molded Surlyn cover, and a carry bag is included.

A compact countertop dishwasher with six place settings and a stainless steel interior. It offers six wash cycles, a delay start of two to eight hours, and an LED display for remaining time. It connects to most kitchen faucets with an adapter.

A kids' cake pop maker toy that lets children prepare a small treat in about 30 seconds without an oven. The kit includes a bain-marie, decorating stands, and other tools, plus a recipe booklet. Food ingredients are not included.

A brass faucet aerator that swivels a full 720 degrees to direct water where needed. It has a soft stream and a stronger spray setting, and its airflow produces a foamy, non-splashing flow. It fits most round kitchen faucets.

A men's golf shoe with a regular fit and lace closure. The upper combines mesh and synthetic materials, and the midsole offers bounce with Boost cushioning at the heel. The upper is made with recycled materials.
A natural straw outback-style hat from Stetson & Dobbs. The vented crown helps with airflow, and the listing is for an extra-large size. The men's model number is OSCLNA-3832.

A set of two clear acrylic apothecary jars, 15 and 20 ounces, with removable lids and wide openings. They hold cotton swabs, cotton balls, bath salts, and similar bathroom items, and they look like glass without the breakage risk.

A rose gold protective case for the Samsung Galaxy On5, with a two-layer design that pairs a rubberized inner layer with a hardened outer shell. It includes a card slot, a swivel belt clip, and a tempered glass screen protector. Phone not included.

A compact electric facial hair remover for women, using dual stainless steel blades to remove fine and coarse hair on the face. It comes with a spare head, and it is designed for portable use at home or while traveling.

specs.straps: Two 9.8 ft tree straps with 18 loops each

record.description: A double-layer hammock with black on one side and orange on the other, sized to fit two adults. It has a rated capacity of 880 pounds, and it folds into an attached bag for carrying. The kit includes tree straps and carabiner clips, and it is TUV certified.

A hooded reindeer costume for dogs in a medium size, suited to Christmas and winter-themed parties. It fastens with Velcro at the neck and chest, and it is designed as a pet outfit for festive occasions.

A motorized standing desk with a 47 by 30 inch wooden top that raises from 29 to 49 inches and tilts from 13 to 45 degrees. Its touch panel stores two height presets, has a child lock, and includes two USB charging ports.

A ten-piece set of pirate-themed figures, including five pirates, a two-part cannon, a treasure chest, an eye patch, and a flag. The hand-painted figures suit imaginative play, dioramas, and party favors, and they are made without phthalates or lead.

specs.cushioning: Gel pads in heel and forefoot

record.description: A blue shoe insert for men's casual and athletic footwear, sized for men's 9 to 10.5. The contoured neutral arch fits most foot types, and gel pads in the heel and forefoot add cushioning. Moisture-wicking treatment helps keep feet dry.

A mid-century style accent armchair in azure, upholstered in soft polyester fabric with subtle piped trim. It has a curved back, gentle recline, and dark walnut-stained legs with non-marking caps. Rated for up to 440 pounds and suited to living rooms, bedrooms, or offices.

A round two-tier lunch container with a stainless steel build and a twist-open lid. The vacuum seal is designed to keep food from leaking and to keep contents fresh, and locking clips hold the tiers together. Free of BPA, and dishwasher and freezer safe.

Printed knit Bermuda pajama shorts in chambray blue, with an elastic waistband and a relaxed fit. The print was drawn by hand by HUE's New York studio design team. The inseam measures about 10.5 inches.

A posable six-inch Falcon figure from Avengers: Infinity War in the S.H.Figuarts line. Extra hands, an alternate head, holographic wings, and two weapons are included, and detachable wing gears let it switch to a flying pose. Recommended for ages 15 and up.
A red 3D decal for the radiator grille of a 2018 Kia Stinger. It sticks on with double-sided adhesive tape and is cut to fit the grille. One set is included, made in Korea.

A stylized vinyl collectible figure of Thor from Avengers: Endgame, standing about 3.75 inches tall. Its painted features show subtle eye differences by design. The figure is best viewed out of its packaging.

Training sweatpants inspired by the My Hero Academia anime, sized XX-Large in a US standard fit. The cotton fabric is soft and suits daily wear, cosplay, and themed parties. It also works as a gift for anime fans.

A 9-foot round patio umbrella in beige with a tilt button and a hand crank for opening. Its polyester canopy is water-resistant and fade-resistant, and an air vent helps release internal pressure. The aluminum pole is rust-resistant. Base sold separately.

specs.contents: Tin planter, liner, seed packets, paint

record.description: A kids' flower-growing kit with a tin planter that can be decorated with paints including a six-color strip. It comes with zinnia, marigold, and cosmos seeds, coconut fiber pucks, and stake markers to label each planting spot.

A men's hiking shoe in walnut with a suede and mesh upper, rubber toe cap for protection, and a breathable mesh lining. A bellows tongue with closed-cell foam keeps out moisture and debris, and the Vibram sole provides grip on trails.

A navy hardside carry-on suitcase with four multi-directional spinner wheels for easy maneuvering. The ABS shell has reinforced corners, and the interior has zippered pockets and a garment panel. The telescoping handle extends to about 41 inches.

specs.care: Hand wash cold, hang or line dry

record.description: A lightweight open-front blazer in red, with a draped silhouette and a soft rayon fabric that has some stretch. It works for offices, parties, dates, and casual outings. Hand wash cold and hang or line dry to care for it.

Lets children build play forts, tents, and tunnels from plastic rods and connector balls. The 120 pieces snap together and apart easily, encouraging teamwork and imaginative play indoors or outdoors. A storage bag is included.

specs.run_time: 3-4 h high heat, 5-6 h low heat

record.description: Heated shoe insoles with a memory foam base and three temperature settings, powered by a rechargeable battery. Three cut-to-fit sizes let you match the heated area to your foot. They are washable and designed to keep feet warm in cold weather.

Metal aviator sunglasses for women with adjustable nose pads and a gold-tone frame. The impact-resistant polycarbonate lenses have a coating that blocks ultraviolet rays. Each pair comes with a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning and safe storage.

Compression pants made from a stretchy polyester and spandex blend, designed to be worn under jerseys or shorts for football and other sports. The snug fit is supportive, and the fabric is quick-drying and machine washable. If you want a looser fit, choose the next size up.

A heavyweight men's car coat made from a thick wool-blend twill for warmth in cold weather. It has a button-front closure and a roomy cut through the chest and waist. The soft, cozy fabric suits everyday winter wear.

A set of twelve decorative gift bows in silver metallic foil, each about four and a half inches across. The back is self-adhesive, so they stick directly onto gift wrap and boxes. They pair well with curly ribbon bows and metallic ribbon.

A Bluetooth car FM transmitter that plays audio from a phone, USB drive, or TF card through your car stereo. It includes a built-in microphone for hands-free calls and two USB charging ports, one with quick charge. The unit has a small footprint with an LED display and ambient lighting.

A red wild bird feeder for oriole jelly, holding 32 ounces. The bottle is inverted so jelly stays fresh and dry, and an internal stirrer releases the right amount. The feeder is simple to clean, and the bottle swaps with most standard 32-ounce jelly jars.

A king-size bed sheet set of white percale woven from Egyptian cotton and made in Italy. The set has a flat sheet, a fitted sheet, and two pillowcases, finished with decorative colored satin stitching. Machine wash on gentle and tumble dry low for best results.

A pack of ten white 42mm festoon LED bulbs for car interior lights, including dome, map, and trunk lamps. Each bulb has sixteen 3528 SMD chips and is rated for about 50,000 hours. Installation is plug-and-play, but if a bulb does not light, turn it 180 degrees.
A gray boat seat that mounts on most boat pedestals. It measures 18 by 21 inches with a 6-inch height, supports up to 400 pounds, and weighs 8 pounds. The seat carries a three-year warranty.

A semi-permanent cream hair color in a deep, cool fuchsia shade that needs no developer. It sits on the outside of the hair shaft rather than penetrating it, so it fades over about four to six weeks. The formula is vegan and free of ammonia and parabens.

A women's mid-height ankle boot in dark brown leather, built for hiking and outdoor trails. It has shock-absorbing cushioning and a rubber lug outsole that grips on uneven ground. The rugged styling suits both trail use and casual outfits.

A structured cap in academy blue with a red accent, featuring a pre-curved visor and a low-profile classic fit. Foam padding in the front panel adds comfort. The microthread fabric dries faster and stretches without absorbing sweat. The UA Freedom program commits to annual donations supporting first responders, military, and veterans.
A compact red microwave with a 0.7 cubic foot interior and a turntable that rotates food as it cooks. It is Daewoo model KOR07R3ZER and comes with the turntable included.
A royal blue flower crown headband that fits most heads. It is handmade and suits bridal parties, flower girls, festivals, and photo shoots. The design is simple and eye-catching.

A black gaming desk with a curved carbon fiber work surface and Z-shaped metal legs. It includes a cup holder, headphone hook, speaker holders, and a cable tray on the back. The desk holds up to 280 pounds and has suction feet to stay in place.

A 1-inch curling iron with an extra-long gold barrel, two inches longer than many standard irons. It reaches up to 430 degrees and has rheostat control for temperature. It has a rotating cool tip, and a heat-resistant mat is included to protect the counter.

Large impact-style gloves in high-visibility orange, with a breathable knit shell and a flexible grip coating. Reinforced areas at high-wear points are meant to extend durability and dampen vibration. The gloves are machine washable and suit handling both small and large objects.

A blue 50cc two-stroke dirt bike for children, with a pull-start and an air-cooled engine. It has a steel frame, front telescopic forks, a rear mono shock, and disc brakes. Its rubber tires are meant for both wet and dry ground, and the throttle can be restricted for slower riding.

A black protective case with a built-in 6000 mAh battery for iPhone 6, 6s, 7, and 8. It can charge the phone and also sync data through the case without removing it. The case works with earphones and AirPods, but it does not support wireless charging or CarPlay, and it offers no screen protection.

A rose gold glitter phone case for the iPhone XR with a hard shell and a soft inner liner. The back panel is made from polycarbonate and the inner layer is TPU, with raised edges around the screen and camera. Cutouts for buttons, ports, and the camera are easy to reach.

A purple PU leather folio wallet case for the Samsung Galaxy S20 5G. The inside has nine card slots, a zippered coin pocket, and two side pockets for cash and ID. It has a detachable hand strap, a magnetic flip closure, and a fold-out kickstand.

specs.securing: Tie-down loops or tuck under tubes

record.description: A black rectangular leaf net for a 16 by 32 foot swimming pool. It is laid over the winter cover before leaves start falling, which keeps debris from settling on the cover and the water. The knitted polyethylene mesh secures with reinforced loops or can be tucked under water tubes.

A set of five blue polyurethane replacement casters for office chairs, with a standard 7/16-inch stem. The wheels roll quietly over hard floors, carpet, and cables without needing a chair mat. The design uses a patented caster system and ABEC-9 bearings.

A refurbished Apple iPhone 8 with 64GB of storage in space gray, locked to AT&T. It is tested for battery health and guaranteed to hold at least 80 percent capacity. The box includes a generic MFi-certified charger and cable, but no headphones or SIM card.
A white floppy-brimmed costume bonnet that adds a touch of Americana to an outfit. It is a one-size style meant for most teens and adults. The bonnet is also offered in red and black.

A heavy-duty gray sewing machine with 32 built-in stitches, including basic, stretch, decorative, and one-step buttonhole stitches. It has a built-in needle threader and a metal frame, and runs at up to 1,100 stitches per minute. Four heavy-duty accessories, including a walking foot and a non-stick foot, are included.

specs.support: Arch support, reinforced heel and toe

record.description: Green men's Chewbacca-themed socks in a large size, with a seamless toe closure for comfort. They have arch support and reinforced heel and toe areas for added durability.

A set of six color-changing gel nail polishes, each 7 ml, packaged in a gift box. The shades shift with the temperature of the nail, and the gel is applied in thin coats over a base coat and cured under an LED lamp. Results can last up to about two weeks.

A set of four red ratchet tie-down straps, each one inch wide and ten feet long, with a 900-pound break strength. Each strap is rated for loads up to 300 pounds. They have metal ratchets, rubber-gripped handles, and PVC-coated hooks, and come in a mesh bag for storage.

Three double-wall glass espresso cups holding five ounces each. The insulated design holds heat for hot beverages and keeps cold ones cool. They suit espresso, cappuccino, macchiato, and tea, and make a simple gift for friends or family.

A forest green silicone case for the iPhone X and XS, with a soft microfiber lining. It covers all four edges and has a 1 mm raised lip around the screen and camera. The case supports wireless charging and can be wiped clean.

A neoprene insulated sleeve that keeps longneck and tall bottles cold, sized for bottles around 22 ounces. The drawstring top holds the bottle snugly. It comes with a shoulder strap and a clip for attaching to a belt or backpack.

A pack of 100 individually sealed one-milliliter plastic syringes, each with a cap that protects the tip. The clearly marked scale helps measure and dispense small amounts of liquid. They suit essential oils, perfume, lab work, and feeding small pets. The listing describes them for industrial or lab use.

A marble-patterned TPU case for the iPhone 7, iPhone 8, and iPhone SE 2020, with a rotating ring kickstand that turns 360 degrees. The printed finish is applied through in-mould decoration, and raised edges help protect the camera. Ports, speakers, and buttons remain fully accessible.

A 60-inch home office desk with a rustic wood-grain top and an X-shaped steel leg frame. The top is about 1.18 inches thick and is rated for 330 pounds. Adjustable feet help it sit level, and assembly takes around 20 minutes with the included hardware.

specs.finish: Brushed matte with polished inner face

record.description: A men's wedding band made from tungsten carbide, 8 millimeters wide, with a brushed matte outer surface and a polished inner face. The ring is durable, weighty, scratch-resistant, and hypoallergenic. It comes in a jewelry box and carries a lifetime warranty covering manufacturing defects and sizing.

specs.spray_modes: Full rainshower, concentrated rinse, combination spray

record.description: A chrome rainshower showerhead with an 8.5-inch spray face and self-pressurizing Immersion technology. It offers full rainshower coverage plus concentrated and combination spray settings. The design is meant for straightforward installation.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: A two-piece set of pocketed terry cloth mitts that work as oven mitts and as hot pads. Each mitt measures about 8.5 by 7.75 inches and is made of 100 percent cotton. Wash in cold water and tumble dry on low, and the set matches other pieces from the Ritz Royale line.

specs.material: Elastic fabric with medical-grade gel separator

record.description: A beige bunion splint with a gel toe separator meant to gradually guide the big toe back toward alignment. Elastic fabric holds it snugly, and a heel loop keeps it from slipping off in bed. The gel separators are washable and reusable, and the brace can be worn day or night.

A black thermoplastic front bumper bracket for holding a license plate on compatible Ford and Lincoln models, with mounting screws included. It is listed for the Ford F-150 from 2006 to 2008 and the Lincoln Mark LT, so check the fitment against your vehicle.

A four-ounce facial toner in a mist bottle, made with vitamin C and witch hazel. The product is meant to prep skin before serums and moisturizers and to help even skin tone. It also contains vitamin E and glycolic acid and is marketed for all skin types, including sensitive or dry skin.

An L-shaped corner desk in vintage wood tone with a thick work surface that can hold three or more monitors. It has an X-shaped crossbar for stability, adjustable leg pads for uneven floors, and roughly 27 inches of clearance underneath. An iron hook and CPU stand are included.

A compact carbon fiber key holder for up to 20 keys, sized to fit a front pocket. It includes a SIM tool and a bottle opener, and is designed so the keys stay secure without daily tightening. An online video shows how to assemble it.

An 11 by 6 inch odor-blocking pouch with a carbon-lined interior and an airtight closure. The bag has a wrist strap and Velcro fastening, and is sized to fit in a backpack or carry by hand. The maker offers a money-back guarantee.

A 12-pound weighted blanket sized 48 by 72 inches for a twin bed, filled with glass beads. It is made of cotton and uses a seven-layer construction to keep the beads contained. Cold-water washing and air drying are recommended, and a duvet cover makes cleaning easier.

A pair of baby blue decorative pillow covers, each 18 by 18 inches, with 3 mm sequins on one face and satin on the other. They have a zipper and are made to hold an 18 by 18 inch insert. The covers suit weddings, holidays, and everyday decor, and can be hand washed and hung to dry.

A ring set with pear-shaped and teardrop cubic zirconia stones, sized 6 and about 0.4 inches wide. It weighs roughly 4 grams and comes with a gift box and favor bag. Suitable for weddings, engagements, anniversaries, and other formal or casual occasions.

A rectangular stainless steel wire rack measuring 17 by 12 inches, for cooling baked goods or elevating food over a sheet pan. Its grid spacing allows airflow without letting small items fall through. The rack is oven safe and can be cleaned in the dishwasher.
Black pigmented tattoo ink in a one ounce bottle, made in the United States. Designed for artists working across many tattoo styles, the pigment is meant to heal bright and true over time.

Replacement adjustable crossbody strap made from soft brown synthetic leather with metal snap hooks. It adjusts from about 43 to 49 inches and is 0.7 inch wide with double-layer taping, suited to swapping out a worn bag strap.

Nighttime sleep aid in tablet form containing doxylamine succinate, supplied as an 80-count bottle with one tablet per dose. The maker says it helps people stay asleep without grogginess, and it is part of a wider line of sleep products.

Set of six stemless champagne flutes made from clear Tritan plastic, each holding 12 ounces. The material is marketed as BPA-free and shatter resistant, and the flutes are listed as dishwasher safe, suited to parties, mimosas, and sparkling drinks.

Synthetic curly half wig with an attached elastic headband and drawstring, in a dark red shade. The 10 inch wavy style is designed to fit head circumferences from about 21.5 to 25 inches. It arrives with an afro puff headwrap, a lash and a hairpin.

Indoor and outdoor projection screen with a 100 inch 16:9 matte PVC surface that resists wrinkles and is easy to wipe clean. A bottom-roll mechanism unfolds for setup with no screws, and a tripod stand and carry bag are included.

A 10 inch French whip for mixing sauces and batters in bowls or saucepans. Its stainless steel wires are sized and weighted for the mixture being whipped, and it can go in the dishwasher. Made in the United States and NSF approved.
Blue lion head vinyl decal, roughly 3.7 by 5 inches. It is made from vinyl that can be peeled off without leaving damage or residue, and installation instructions are included.

Two-sided playset based on the Keia character from a preschool show, with a treehouse, a 3 inch poseable figure, and accessories. Features include a kid-powered elevator, a spinning lookout, a bouncy chair, and a flower shower, recommended for ages 3 and up.

Binder pages in a pack of 25, each with poly sleeves for four discs, two on each side. The listing gives a 100 disc capacity. Measuring 5.75 by 10 inches, they fit standard three ring binders and help guard discs against fingerprints and scratches.
Coffee brewer from Bunn, model AXIOM-15-3, rated for 120 volt, 60 Hertz, single phase power. Made in the United States, it ships as one unit in a box measuring about 27 by 56 by 61 centimeters.

Men's insulated snow pants with a waterproof, windproof shell and a polyester lining. The 120 gram insulation is quilted in place, and the pants include two waterproof zip pockets, two hook-and-loop pockets, and adjustable waist and ankle closures.

Hand-painted decorative sloth figurine resting on a tree, from the Heartwood Creek collection by Jim Shore. Made of stone resin with detailed styling, it comes in an individual box and measures about 4.25 by 1.5 by 2.88 inches.

Wired plaid ribbon in fall tones of orange and green with metallic gold stripes. The thin monofilament wire along each edge lets it hold loops and bows, and it suits gift wrap, floral work, wreaths, and other seasonal crafts.

Men's long sleeve plaid button-front shirt in a classic fit with extra room through the shoulders, chest, and body. It has longer sleeves and shirttails, button cuffs and collar, and one open pocket on the front.
Five string bass guitar with a maple neck, spalted maple top over a mahogany body, and rosewood fretboard with white dot inlays. It has medium frets and a B15 bridge, finished in brown.

Daily body wash for dry, itchy skin that cleanses while leaving skin feeling moisturized. Its oat-based formula is fragrance-free, soap-free, and dye-free, and it is intended for sensitive skin. The 33 ounce bottle is suited to everyday use.

Zip-up footed sleeper for babies from newborn to 9 months, made from organic cotton. It has a looser fit for play and sleep, non-slip grips on the feet, a diagonal zip front for quick diaper changes, and a large gusset for movement.

Compact 18 watt USB-C wall charger with Power Delivery 3.0 and a foldable plug, about one inch thick. It suits phones and tablets such as iPhone 12 models, as well as other devices rated for 30 watts or less, and includes built-in protection against overcurrent, overheating, and overcharging.

Set of three nickel-plated candle stands with sculpted double heart designs and rhinestone accents, suited to unity candle ceremonies or romantic decor. The large stand holds a three inch pillar candle and stands 4.5 inches tall, while the two taper stands are 4 inches tall.

Men's driving-style loafer made of soft black leather with an embossed crocodile logo. The flexible moccasin construction and cushioned foam insole are designed for comfort, and the shoe slips on easily.

Two seat convertible loveseat with a hardwood frame, five-position backrest adjustable from 90 to 180 degrees, and foldable armrests that open into a sleeping surface. The set includes two pillows, and the cover can be removed for cleaning.
Men's graphic t-shirt in burgundy, made of 100% cotton with a soft wash feel. It is machine washable and has a tagless neck label for comfort.

Halloween costume for toddlers, a Buzz Lightyear outfit with a full bodysuit, soft fabric wings, gloves, and a cap. The wings attach with self-stick tabs, the back closes with self-stick fabric for easy dressing, and the costume has glitter accents and padding at the waist, knees, and leg cuffs.

Set of three reusable stainless steel straws for drinking mate, tea, and cocktails. The flared base has small slots that let liquid through while blocking chunky material, and the spoon-shaped end helps scoop out used mate when cleaning. Each straw is about six inches long.

Summer learning workbook for children moving from grade 4 into grade 5, with about 15 minutes of activities per day. It covers reading, writing, math, science, and social studies, and includes flash cards, stickers, a certificate, and an answer key across 160 pages.

Set of two hand woven gray baskets made from natural cotton rope, sized 12 and 10 inches. They can hold indoor plants or be used to store toys, crafts, and towels. The minimal design suits a variety of room decor.

Men's analog quartz dress watch with a stainless steel case about 44.5 millimeters across and a black leather alligator-style strap. It has a curved mineral crystal and is water resistant to 30 meters, suitable for splashes or brief immersion but not swimming.

Neoprene sunglass retainer about 19 inches long and one inch wide, designed to float and to sit around the arms of glasses or hang around the neck. It is waterproof, stain resistant, and suited to running, cycling, fishing, and other outdoor or water activities, usable in salt or fresh water.

specs.care: Clean with soap and water, not dishwasher safe

record.description: Set of four clear plastic storage bins with built-in carry handles and open tops, for organizing supplies in a filing cabinet, desk drawer, or closet shelf. They suit office supplies, phones, and craft items, and are easy to see into and to clean.

Pair of decorative cushion covers in a cream and black blend, measuring 18 by 18 inches, made from 100% polyester with a chenille-style texture. They have an invisible zipper and are sold without inserts. Machine wash on a gentle cycle.

specs.filling: Natural grain and dried French lavender

record.description: Microwavable plush toy filled with natural grain and dried French lavender for warmth and a soothing scent. It is built to United States safety standards for every age group and uses soft, high-quality fabric, suited to bedtime, travel, or soothing tummies.

Set of 12 soft foam blocks in bright primary colors for toddlers to stack, build, and sort by color. Each block measures six inches per side. The foam is CertiPUR certified, and the set carries GREENGUARD Gold and ASTM F963 toy safety certifications. Wipe with mild soap and water.

Lightweight water-repellent backpack for travel, hiking, camping, or daily use, with a padded laptop compartment and a sleeve for sliding onto rolling luggage. Exterior and interior pockets include a shoe compartment and a removable hard case for sunglasses, and it measures 18 by 13 by 9 inches.

Slim, matte TPU case for the iPhone 11 Pro Max only, not for the standard iPhone 11 or 11 Pro. It adds little bulk, has raised edges for a snug fit, and aligns cutouts for buttons, camera, flash, speakers, and the Lightning port. Backed by a 180 day quality guarantee.
Women's classic fit lightweight long sleeve crewneck sweater in black, size large. It has ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem, and is made of soft, light yarn that moves easily with the wearer.

Vegetarian capsule supplement providing 250 mcg of iodine per capsule from dried sea kelp grown in the United States. Each bottle holds 60 capsules, about a two month supply, and the product is free of soy, gluten, GMO ingredients, and artificial additives.

Expandable carry-on backpack with a water-resistant polyester body that opens with a 180 degree zipper like a suitcase. It has a main compartment with a laptop sleeve for up to a 17.3 inch device, a front organizer, a hidden shoulder strap, and an anti-theft back pocket.

Mars Black acrylic paint in a 75 milliliter tube. The opaque pigment blends smoothly and dries to a waterproof finish. The non-toxic paint meets ASTM D 4236 and is made in India and has peggable tubes.
Extra long red and white striped Santa hat for teens and adults, about 32 inches long. It is made of felt and faux fur with a pom-pom topper and trimmed fur, a festive accessory for holiday outfits.

Checked 28 inch upright suitcase in rose gold, made of ABS with an expandable design that adds two more inches. It rolls on eight multi-directional wheels, has a retractable trolley handle, and includes zippered organizer pockets, elastic shoe pockets, and a garment restraint.

Two-pack of men's short sleeve pocket t-shirts in white, size extra large. Made of pre-shrunk cotton with a small chest pocket, reinforced seams at the neck and shoulders, and a tagless back neck label, meant to hold up through repeated wear.

Padded vanity stool with a black frame and solid wood legs and a beige cushioned seat. The high-density sponge seat is covered in polyester and the legs have carved detail, and the stool is rated for up to 250 pounds, suitable for dressing tables, dining, or piano use.

Navy kitchen island with a 1.5 inch solid wood butcher block top for meal prep or extra serving area. Built from hardwood and birch veneer, it has two smooth-glide drawers and three cabinets, with brushed nickel hardware. Choose casters for a mobile cart or feet to keep it stationary.

Set of 60 fine point permanent markers in a wide range of bright colors. The quick drying ink is waterproof, smear proof, and fade resistant on paper, plastic, wood, metal, and glass. Made to ASTM D-4236 and EN71 standards, they are labeled for children three and older.

Grey sneakers from the Superstar line, with a blue star and a blue heel tab in smooth leather. The upper is made of cowhide leather blended with polyester, and the rubber sole is intended to give a soft, cushioned step.
Men's slip-on sneaker in grey and white with a no-sew mesh upper and molded structural underlays. Sized US 13 medium, it is intended to provide a performance-oriented fit.

Marine digital media receiver in white with built-in Bluetooth, a front USB input, and playback of MP3, WMA, AAC, WAV, and FLAC files. Its speakers are dual cone units measuring 6.5 inches, in an IPx5 water-resistant design, and it is ready for SiriusXM satellite radio.

Bare circuit board switching power supply that converts 100 to 240 volt AC input to 24 volt DC output, rated around 150 watts. It includes over-voltage, over-current, and short circuit protection, and is intended for industrial control systems. It weighs about 200 grams.

Machine-woven area rug with a Moroccan ombre pattern in silver and black, measuring 8 by 10 feet. Its synthetic fibers resist stains and shed very little, and the pile is about 0.45 inches thick. Suitable for busy rooms, it can be vacuumed and spot cleaned with mild detergent.

A soft faux fur throw in black with a plush front and fluffy sherpa reverse. Works draped over a couch, chair, or bed, and can be tucked between a comforter and sheet for extra warmth. Made from microfiber that resists fading and staining and stays gentle on sensitive skin.
A women's slide sandal from Ted Baker in a yellow colorway, listed in US size 8.5 regular. The listing provides few other details, so fit and materials should be confirmed before purchase.

A 16 by 16 inch throw pillow with a double-sided print of a campfire and white lettering, aimed at camping fans who enjoy a drink with friends. The cover is spun polyester and the pillow is filled with polyester and sewn shut. A humorous gift for campers.
adidas no-show socks in a six-pack, built with a lightweight fit and a knit adidas wordmark on the outside of the foot. The yarn wicks sweat to help keep feet dry during activity.

specs.closure: Elastic ankle strap with heel zipper

record.description: Black flat shoes with an elastic ankle strap and a zipper at the heel for easy on and off. The upper uses soft faux suede, and the sole is contoured with a textured grip. Suited to casual, semi-formal, or work settings with a range of outfits.

Framed giclee canvas print of a simple floral design in gray and yellow with an abstract look. Printed on waterproof canvas and stretched over a pine frame, it arrives ready to hang with a hook already mounted. Colors may appear slightly different depending on monitor settings.

A full-figure underwire bra in ivory, size 34G, with two-part seamed full-coverage cups intended for lift and shape. Sheer mesh panels sit at the top of the cups, and the band and sides are designed to lie smooth. It has a leotard-style back.

Individual silk-mink hybrid eyelash extensions in deep black, offered in 0.07 and 0.10 mm thicknesses and a range of L-series curls. Lengths run from 8 to 15 mm in mixed or single sizes. Lashes come off the strip cleanly with little residue or kinking.

A natural-colored indoor and outdoor lounger for babies that folds into a backpack in one motion. It weighs under four pounds and includes a detachable play bar and shade canopy. The base is waterproof and the cover can go in the washing machine.

specs.material: Polycarbonate shell, TPU bumper, silicone liner

record.description: A three-layer protective case in yellow for iPod touch 5th, 6th, and 7th generation models. A hard outer shell and soft inner silicone layer absorb drops, while a raised bezel guards the screen and camera. Snap-on design with cutouts for buttons, ports, and charging, and dust caps for the port.

A refillable pump dispenser for liquid soap, hand sanitizer, or essential oils, sized for bathroom vanities and kitchen sinks. It holds up to twelve ounces, and the pump head lifts off for easy refilling through the wide opening. Frosted plastic that won't rust; clean by hand rather than in a dishwasher.

specs.coverage: Up to 500 sq. ft. per kit

record.description: A six-piece kit of self-leveling polycuramine coating for interior concrete floors such as garage floors, workshops, and basements. It cures to a high-gloss, terrazzo-style finish that resists chemical spills and hot tire pickup. Each kit covers up to about 500 square feet, and foot traffic is possible after 8 to 10 hours.

A wireless trackpad with a built-in rechargeable battery that pairs automatically with a Mac. Four force sensors beneath the glass let you click anywhere and register differences in pressure. The glass surface is nearly 30 percent larger than the earlier model and sits on a lower profile.

Vetiver incense sticks with a heavy, earthy, sweet scent, made from herbs, resins, woods, and oils. Each stick is about eleven inches long, and the package holds 68 sticks totaling 200 grams. The light scent is meant for meditation, yoga, and general relaxation.

An unlined mesh bralette in black with dotted mesh cups and stretch lace trim at the cups, underarm, and underband. Double rouleau elastic straps adjust for fit, and the rose gold tone hardware adds a finish. Size large.

A red pizza oven that handles frozen, pre-baked, and fresh dough pizzas. It includes a removable stone for even, crisp crusts, plus upper and lower heating elements and a preheat function. Temperature is adjustable up to about 680 degrees Fahrenheit.

A black women's three-in-one winter jacket with a waterproof outer shell and a removable insulating liner, so it can be worn together or separately. The Teflon-coated exterior resists water and dirt, and a detachable hood with a drawstring helps block wind, while zip pockets hold small essentials.

A deluxe feather headdress for Halloween costumes or role play, made from large faux feathers in black, white, and blue. White marabou trim lines the sides. It is one size and fits most teens and adults.

A women's automatic Rolex President Datejust in 18k yellow gold, reference 179178, listed in excellent condition. The listing states the watch is authenticated, has been serviced as needed, and carries a one-year warranty, with a final quality control check before shipment.

Six pairs of women's crew socks in assorted printed designs and colors, made in Korea. The blend is mostly combed cotton with spandex and polyester for softness, moisture wicking, and a firm, elastic fit. Suited to both athletic activity and everyday styling.

A two-in-one matte lip crayon kit that pairs a pointed lip liner with a built-in balm. The matte crayon is light and buildable, and the balm adds hydration or a glossy shine over lipstick. Six shades range from natural nudes to bold reds.

A 9-foot beige patio umbrella with a push-button tilt to adjust shade and a crank winder for height. The powder-coated aluminum frame has rectangular steel ribs, and the water-resistant polyester canopy includes a top vent for airflow. The base stand is sold separately.

A four-pack of mulled cider scented candles in glass jars, each with three wicks and about 11.5 ounces of candle. Scented to add fragrance to a room and a simple touch of color to home decor, and suited to gatherings. Store in a cool place.

specs.sizing: Comes in regular and plus sizes

record.description: A high-waisted mid-thigh shaping short in soft nude, built with a targeted panel to support the lower stomach. The breathable microfiber is lightweight, and the cotton gusset is designed to avoid visible panty lines. Comes in regular and plus sizes.

specs.care: Machine wash cool, tumble dry low

record.description: A four-pack of girls' racerback seamless crop bralettes in white, sized 6 to 7. Each has spaghetti straps and removable pads, with a smooth, tag-free construction meant for sensitive skin. Lightweight stretch fabric suits everyday wear and sports. Machine wash cool and tumble dry low.

A waterproof women's work boot with a six-inch shaft, built on a women's last for fit. It is made of full-grain leather with a waterproof membrane, and has an alloy toe, an all-weather TPU outsole, and a polyurethane midsole. The footbed uses anti-fatigue technology.

Compact 10x25 binoculars in black with a rubber-armored housing that resists water to a depth of about five meters. A central focus knob gives quick, precise adjustment, and the outer lenses have multicoating and water-repelling coatings that resist dirt and scratches. Suited to long-distance viewing in demanding conditions.

A slim black case for the Samsung Galaxy Tab S4 10.5 (2018) that holds a detachable Bluetooth keyboard with spring-backed keys and a seven-color backlight. The adjustable stand supports landscape viewing, and the case has a pocket for an S Pen, which is sold separately. The tablet is not included.

Wide, colorful disposable plastic straws about 8.2 inches long and 0.43 inches across, suited to thick drinks like smoothies, milkshakes, and bubble tea. Eight assorted colors come mixed, and the straws can be washed and reused or used for craft projects. Suitable for picnics, parties, and barbecues.

Women's lace-up climbing and bouldering shoe in purple, with a leather upper that offers some stretch and breathability. The lacing allows fine-tuned fit, and the smooth last suits long sessions. Built around a narrower, higher-instep women's foot shape, though male climbers with narrow feet may also fit it.

A box of 25 letter-size two-pocket folders in green, with a glossy laminated finish that resists tearing better than standard paper. Each pocket holds up to 50 sheets, and the interior has a die-cut slot for a business card. Useful for presentations, client materials, or school projects.

Convertible mitten gloves in gray that flip open into fingerless gloves using magnets, which keeps fingers free for handling gear or a phone. Insulated with 40 grams of Thinsulate, with a windproof membrane and silicone palm grips for a secure hold. Reflective strips and pull rings help with visibility and easy removal.

Black men's slim-fit dress pants with a flat front and tapered legs. The fit runs through the hip and thigh and sits below the waist. The silky polyester twill moves with you, and two welt pockets sit at the rear. Sized 28 inches at the waist and 28 inches in length.

A lightweight women's hooded jacket in off-white with a faux sheepskin lining. It is meant to block wind and light rain, and its fixed hood has a soft lining. It closes with a continuous double zipper, and two pockets have hidden zips. It can be stored in its own pouch.

Six pairs of baby crew socks for 6 to 12 months, with three mesh pairs for airflow and three thermal waffle-knit pairs for warmth. Cushioned soles and non-skid grippers help reduce slipping. The socks are machine washable and can be tumble-dried.

Sheer organza ribbon in hot red, designed for making bows, wreaths, and floral arrangements. The wired edges let loops and shapes hold their form. It is waterproof, so it suits outdoor holiday decor, and it comes on 25-yard spools that are 1.5 inches wide.

specs.fits: 3 in OD to 3 in ID pipe

record.description: A preformed 3-inch lap joint band clamp in 304 stainless steel for joining exhaust pipes, mufflers, and catalytic converters. It connects a 3-inch OD pipe to a 3-inch ID pipe in a slip fit, spreading clamping force evenly around the joint to reduce leaks. The clamp is reusable and needs no welding.

A 9-by-12-foot drop cloth woven from 100% cotton canvas, meant to protect floors, carpets, and furniture indoors or outdoors. It soaks up paint spills and traps dust and debris. Double-stitched seams help prevent fraying, and the cloth can be machine washed for repeated use.

Thirty disposable clear plastic martini glasses, each about five ounces, with a stemmed cup and base that give a glass-like look. They suit desserts, mousse, appetizers, and beverages at weddings, birthday parties, and other events. Each can be discarded or washed and reused.

Two cases of white athletic field marking paint, 24 aerosol cans in total. Each 18-ounce can has a universal tip and is made for inverted use with the Ameri-Stripe aerosol machine, and it dries quickly after a single coat. It is intended for line striping sports fields and works with nearly all marking machines.

Rectangular full-rim plastic sunglasses in dark havana with green silver mirror lenses. Lens width is 57 mm with an 18 mm bridge and 145 mm arms. The lenses are non-polarized and offer 100 percent UV protection.
Women's eau de parfum from Versace's Eros line, sold as a 0.17-ounce splash bottle. The listing gives no further detail on notes or packaging, so check the product page or the bottle before buying.

A lightweight long women's hooded down jacket in black, filled with 650 fill-power down. Heat-sealed construction is meant to hold in warmth, and the outer shell repels light moisture. Secure hand pockets and a dual zipper complete the design.

A small foldable quadcopter drone with four channels for climbing, descending, flying in four directions, and performing 360-degree rolls. It supports GPS return-to-home and headless mode, and the arms can be replaced if broken. This listing is for the version without a camera.

Three pairs of reusable black silicone ear plugs in small, medium, and large, so you can pick a fit. The oval shape follows the ear canal, and a hook design helps keep them in place during sleep. The listing claims a noise reduction rating of 31 dB. They can be washed and reused.

A light blue denim maxi skirt with a high rise, curved waist, and contrast stitching. It falls to about 35 inches and fastens with three buttons and a zipper. Front and back pockets are functional. Sizing is listed in a chart in the photos, since sizes vary by maker.

Mid-rise 7/8-length performance leggings in black with blue side stripes, designed for training with full coverage. The flat, wide waistband and flatlock seams are meant for comfort and movement. The inseam is 25 inches, and the front rise is 10 inches.

An oval embossed tin sign with a Bar and Shield logo and Harley-Davidson script, measuring 18 by 10.5 inches. The die-cut shape is raised and embossed with a custom graphic. It has holes for hanging on a garage, shop, or other wall.

Four pairs of oversized square reading glasses for women, with spring hinges and a 47 mm frame height. Each pair has a single magnification strength chosen at purchase, so the pack does not mix powers. The plastic frames are meant for everyday office or home use.

A slim, flexible silicone case for iPhone 7 Plus and 8 Plus, printed with a smoke-colored skeleton design. The cover has openings for the audio jack, charger cable, and volume buttons, and it is easy to remove. Only the case is included, and a stylus is offered as a free extra.
A pack of eight multicolored, over-dyed six-strand cotton thread skeins for needlework and other handcraft projects. Each skein holds about 8.7 yards, so the pack covers a range of stitching work.

An 85-inch 4K smart television using a quantum dot QLED panel with dual LED backlighting for vivid color and contrast. It includes built-in Alexa voice control and a slim design, and its processor upscales lower-resolution content toward 4K.

A silver-toned promise ring with a round inlaid stone, crafted from 18K white gold. It is designed as a couples band and suits anniversaries, birthdays, and holidays. Keep it stored in its box and remove it before swimming or bathing.

A long-sleeve fishing shirt for men with a tribal-style graphic and a classic cut. The polyester interlock fabric dries quickly and uses UV-absorbent yarns to help block ultraviolet rays, suiting time on the water or at camp.
A five-pack of men's undershirts in grey and black, sized X-Large. The solid shirts are 100 percent cotton, with a soft feel, moisture-wicking finish, and tagless construction for comfort.

A men's smartwatch with a 43 mm brass case, black leather strap, and a white dial. It tracks steps, distance, calories, and sleep, and syncs with a phone over Bluetooth. Rated water resistant to 50 meters for short swims.

A running shoe for kids with a laceless BOA dial closure for a fast, precise fit. The synthetic and mesh upper stays breathable, and a lightweight midsole and rubber outsole provide cushioning and grip. Suits children roughly eight to twelve years old.

An adjustable hair clipper with an alloy housing and a carbon steel blade that sets from 000 to 1 and can be zero-gapped. Its XTR design is meant to keep the clipper running cooler and quieter, and the duo-tone body is ergonomic.
A full-length hooded bathrobe for men made from Turkish cotton with loops on both sides for absorbency. It has a wide hood, patch pockets, and a self-fabric belt, and it is machine washable.

A red gaming chair with a sturdy metal frame and adjustable seat height. It swivels 360 degrees, reclines between 90 and 170 degrees, and includes a removable headrest and a USB-powered lumbar massage cushion. Assembly takes about 20 minutes with the included tools.

A floor-length ball gown in royal blue sequined tulle, with a sweetheart neckline, beaded detailing, and 3D floral decorations. Sized as a 6 and made to order, it suits quinceanera, prom, and formal events. Measurements should be sent before ordering.

A youth-size orange short-sleeve tee with a Tampa Bay football fan graphic. It is made of cotton, pre-shrunk, and screen printed in the USA, and it can be machine washed. The design is copyrighted by Smack Apparel.
