A wireless presentation clicker with a laser pointer that works with Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android. It pairs over a USB receiver or Bluetooth LE and runs about a year on one AAA battery. Discontinued by the manufacturer.
A chrome replacement tub spout designed for pull-out diverter hand shower setups on Delta faucets. It is made to original specifications and fits standard 1/2-inch or 3/4-inch pipe.

A two-piece gift set with a stainless steel mechanical pencil and a ballpoint pen in silver. The pencil takes 0.7 mm HB lead and the pen uses 0.8 mm black ink, with a knurled grip and a quiet retractor.

A quilted heated mattress pad in white, king size. Two side controllers each offer ten heat levels, and an auto-off feature provides reassurance. The polyester pad is machine washable and dryer safe, and carries a five-year limited warranty.

A black trunk-mounted rack that carries three bicycles, with individual tie-downs and a padded lower frame to protect the vehicle. It folds flat for storage and arrives fully assembled, with left and right side straps for stability.

A floor-length maxi dress in burgundy with a ruched empire waist and a thigh-high side slit. The off-shoulder neckline has elastic lining and can be worn four ways, including strapless. Suited to casual, evening, and beach occasions.
A men's quartz wristwatch with a wooden case and stainless steel band, packed in a bamboo box. Engraving on the back is an option. It is not waterproof, and the band adjusts with a supplied tool.
A 14-inch quartz wall clock with a cream dial and raised hour markers. Individual bronze rods frame the face in a modern style that draws on two prism patterns from a Frank Lloyd Wright building.

specs.network: Unlocked, works with major US carriers

record.description: An unlocked 5.7-inch smartphone in silver with 32 GB of storage. It has a 13 MP main rear camera, a 5 MP ultra-wide rear lens, a 5 MP front camera, and a 3,000 mAh battery.

A double-sided tabletop makeup mirror with a regular side and a 10X magnifying side. The optical glass mirror measures about 5.8 inches and rotates 360 degrees to hold any angle. It is light enough for handheld use too.

specs.contents: Tote, tool set, pens, blade, digital guide

record.description: An accessory bundle for the Cricut Joy machine that includes a padded carry tote, a three-piece tool set, three fine-point pens, and a spare blade. A digital beginner guide is emailed to the buyer. Blade housing and the machine are sold separately.
A dainty gold-toned necklace with a hammered evil eye pendant and a small cubic zirconia accent. It has a 16.5-inch chain with a 2-inch extension, is plated over brass, and comes in a gift box.

A hand-carved pink Himalayan salt lamp on a natural neem wood base, with an integrated dimmer for adjusting its warm glow. It arrives fully assembled with a spare 15-watt bulb and comes in a gift box.

A six-cup stovetop espresso maker in white, made of anodized aluminum for brewing moka-style coffee. It works on gas and electric stoves and includes a silicone gasket. The aluminum body should be hand washed.
A men's lace-up sneaker in white tint, black, and white, with a knit upper and mesh lining. It has an OrthoLite sockliner for cushioning and a speed lacing system for quick fit.

Two pairs of 5 mm magnetic stud earrings, one white and one black, set with cubic zirconia. The stainless steel body resists rust and staining, and the magnetic clasp means no piercing post is needed.

Women's plus-size knit Bermuda shorts in white with a relaxed fit and an elastic pull-on waist. They have a 12-inch inseam and side pockets, and are made from a cotton-polyester blend that is machine washable.

A pink 10-inch silicone-coated whisk with a non-slip stainless steel handle that has a hanging hole. It is made to handle high heat and will not damage pots or pans, and it works for whisking, beating, and stirring.
A tri-fold women's wallet in rose red soft synthetic leather with a cat-and-bow charm. It holds 13 cards, two clear photo slots, bills, and coins in a kiss-lock pocket, and it closes with a snap.

specs.dimensions: 17 H x 38 W x 16 D inches

record.description: A grey tufted storage bench with a hardwood frame and bonded leather upholstery, finished with crystal-like accents. Its padded top works as a footrest or extra seat, and it offers ample storage for a bedroom, entryway, or living room.

A set of 60 permanent adhesive vinyl sheets in 30 colors, each 12 by 12 inches, plus 10 clear transfer sheets. The vinyl is BPA and PVC free and suits crafting projects on smooth surfaces, indoors and out. Not intended for fabric.

A slim two-part case for the iPhone X, with a rubber inner layer and a polycarbonate outer shell. It has a raised edge to protect the screen and is sold as certified refurbished, with a minimum 90-day warranty.

A women's full-zip fleece jacket in navy with a collared neck and two zippered side pockets. It is made of soft 100 percent polyester fleece and has a lightweight, classic fit suited to cold-weather outdoor activity.

A rechargeable sonic electric toothbrush for adults with five modes and three intensities. It charges by USB and lasts up to 60 days per charge. A two-minute timer signals every 30 seconds to move to another area, and a cover protects the bristles.

Six bunches of live giant hairgrass, a freshwater aquarium plant with a sturdy root system that draws nutrients from the substrate. It forms a background cover, about 5 to 10 inches tall, and helps oxygenate the tank.

A wearable fleece blanket for big kids with a dog-themed design, in cream and size 2/3T. Its roomy sack shape lets kids move their legs but keeps the blanket from being kicked off, with openings for their feet.
A men's two-piece pajama set with a crewneck top and relaxed-fit bottoms made of cotton. The design carries a Star Trek: The Next Generation theme, and the waist has no fly string.

A men's burgundy and brown leather lug-sole shoe with a handsewn upper stitched to the midsole and a rawhide lacing system for a custom fit. It has a leather lining, EVA insert, and extra foam cushioning under the forefoot.

specs.dimensions: 61.75 W x 33.75 D x 27.75 H inches
specs.seat: 45 W x 23.5 D x 17.75 H inches

record.description: A traditional Chesterfield loveseat finished in navy blue and dark brown. Deep button tufting and individually applied nail head accents decorate the piece, which has scrolled arms and turned legs. It measures about 62 inches wide.

specs.parts: 3 plates, hose adaptor, sealing tape, 4 screws

record.description: A sliding window vent kit for a portable air conditioner, with three adjustable plates and a 5.9-inch exhaust hose adaptor. The plates extend to fit vertical or horizontal sash windows, and included sealing tape and screws complete the set.

specs.fit: Unisex crew, runs large for women
specs.print: Screen printed Hawkins AV Club design

record.description: A unisex crewneck sweatshirt in maroon with a white screen-printed Hawkins Middle School AV Club design. The 50/50 blend is soft and comfortable, and the fit typically runs large on women.

A 3.5-gallon bucket with a clear acrylic viewing window for looking below the water surface, suited to small boats and shore use. The 5/8-inch rope handle is easy to grip, and a lens protector lets you fill the bucket without scratching the window.

A cordless handheld pool vacuum that cleans leaves, dirt, and sand from in-ground and above-ground pools without hoses. Its rechargeable battery runs up to 45 minutes, and a larger debris bag holds more dirt. A telescopic pole is sold separately.

A full-frame DSLR camera in black with a 20.1-megapixel CMOS sensor and DIGIC X processor. It records 4K video, has dual CFexpress card slots, and shoots up to 16 frames per second. A CFexpress card and reader are included in this bundle.

A rustic wooden wall sign spelling HOME, made of square tiles with white lettering. Hooks and string come pre-installed for hanging. It suits kitchens, living rooms, and dining rooms, and makes a housewarming gift.

A fixed black wall mount for flat-panel TVs and monitors from 37 to 80 inches, rated for up to 130 pounds. Its brackets sit about 1.84 inches off the wall, and it shifts sideways to center a TV between studs. It arrives pre-assembled and is UL-listed.

specs.pieces: Tension rod, 22-inch and 40-inch rods, 2 end caps

record.description: A white spring-loaded tension rod that extends from about 83 to 120 inches to hold curtains without drilling. Its powder-coated steel resists rust, and it fits smooth or rough surfaces. It suits bathrooms, bedrooms, windows, and laundry areas.

A black powder-coated steel storage cabinet on swivel casters, standing 72 inches tall with four adjustable shelves. It holds up to 600 pounds total, with a built-in lock and two keys. Assembly is required, and the cabinet suits garages, kitchens, and offices.

A soft long-sleeved romper for newborns and infants, made from a stretchy cotton blend. The expandable neckline and snap fastenings make dressing and diaper changes easier. Machine or hand washable, suited to daily wear or as a shower gift.

A hardcover ruled notebook from Moleskine's limited Sakura edition, measuring about 5 by 8.25 inches with 240 pages. It has an elastic closure band and inner storage folders. The ivory paper suits ballpoint, pencil, and fountain pen writing.

Lightweight navy first-walker sneakers for babies, with a breathable mesh upper and a flexible rubber sole. Cushioned memory foam footbeds and a toe cap add comfort and protection. The stretchy knit collar lets little feet slip in and out easily.

A temporary violet hair color wax that doubles as a styling wax for shaping and texture. It suits parties, cosplay, and festivals and rinses out with warm water. It is meant for use on slightly damp hair, and the hair sets firm as it dries.

A 120-watt LED nail lamp for curing gel polish, with a built-in timer offering 10, 30, 60, or 99 second cycles. It comes with a compact 24-watt mini lamp, a nano glass file, and toe separators. The unit includes an LCD display and works on 100 to 240 volts.

A white 7-speed electric hand mixer with a turbo boost, built with a copper motor. It includes two beaters, two dough hooks, and storage that keeps attachments with the unit. The beaters and hooks are dishwasher safe, and the body wipes clean with a damp cloth.

A full-motion wall mount for flat-screen TVs and monitors in the 19 to 40 inch range. Its arm tilts, swivels, and rotates so the screen can be set to landscape or portrait, and it extends away from the wall. It supports up to 33 pounds and fits VESA 75 and 100 patterns.

A cream-colored acrylic yarn with a soft silk-like sheen, sold as a set of four skeins totaling about 1,532 yards. It works for knitting and crochet, with recommended needles from US 1.5 to 4 and a 3.5 mm hook. It is lightweight and suited to spring and summer garments.

A decorative 18 by 18 inch cushion cover with a watercolor cowboy and horse design printed on both sides. The cover is made from a blend of cotton and linen and closes with a hidden zipper on one side. Insert not included; machine wash cold on a gentle cycle.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: A reversible sherpa throw in a bright floral and geometric patchwork pattern, suited to cottage or boho decor. The 60 by 50 inch blanket is made of polyester and works in a living room, on a bed, or in a nursery. It can be machine washed cold and tumble dried on low.

A rechargeable touch-operated stick-on light with eight SMD LEDs and a dimmable touch control. Its 1230 mAh battery runs up to five hours on full brightness. It remembers the last brightness setting and charges through a micro-USB cable.

Two golden yellow velvet cushion covers in a striped pattern, sized 20 by 20 inches for sofas, beds, and chairs. The polyester fabric has a soft touch and a hidden zipper for easy swapping. Inserts are not included; wash in cold water on a gentle cycle.

Individually wrapped essential oil towelettes for cleaning hands and surfaces without the harshness of alcohol-based products. They are travel sized to carry in a bag, pocket, or backpack. The wipes are made to use right away with no prior training.

A red spruce wreath decorated with pine cones and 50 battery-powered LED lights for a front door. The lights run on a timer that is on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours. Batteries are not included, and the wreath is suited for indoor or outdoor holiday display.

A flexible, reversible tree pole cover that hides the pole at the base of an artificial Christmas tree. One side shows a bark print and the other a candy pattern. It can be folded or trimmed to fit, and it comes in a package that can store it after the holidays.

A small round black crossbody bag made of PU leather with gold-tone hardware and a snakeskin-print front pocket. It can be worn as a shoulder bag or crossbody. Inside are a main compartment and zip and open pockets, large enough for a phone, keys, and a wallet.

A metallic red four-slice toaster with a brushed stainless housing and two control panels, effectively two toasters in one. It offers six browning settings plus reheat, defrost, and bagel buttons with LED indicators. Wide slots, an extra-lift lever, and a slide-out crumb tray round out the design.

specs.fits: Select Chevrolet, GMC, and Isuzu models

record.description: A replacement front driver side window regulator for select Chevrolet, GMC, and Isuzu vehicles, finished in black. It is designed to match the fit and function of the original part and was cycle-tested in a door. Check the fitment for your exact make, model, and trim before ordering.

specs.blend: Garlic, parsley, chlorophyll, aged black garlic

record.description: Odorless garlic softgels rated at 1000 mg, combined with parsley, chlorophyll, and aged black garlic extract. The formula uses flaxseed oil as a carrier. It is marketed for heart health, blood pressure and cholesterol support, and general immune support.

A student E-flat alto saxophone with a red lacquered brass body and gold-toned keys. It has a high F# key, a connected C#-Bb table key, and a hardened blue steel spring. Included are a mouthpiece, ligature, cap, a light case with backpack straps, a cleaning cloth, and a carrying strap.
A short-sleeved wrap dress in an ivory and black abstract floral print. It has flutter sleeves and a surplice neckline. Sized small, it is designed for women.

Five hundred unwrapped glossy black plastic straws in a dispenser box, each about 7.75 inches long. They are made from food-grade, BPA-free polypropylene that resists cracking and melting in ordinary use. They suit soft and hard drinks, though thicker straws work better for shakes and smoothies.

A pair of nylon mesh replacement filter bags for Polaris 360 and 380 pool cleaners. The bags have a zipper for emptying debris and attach with a snap-on hook-and-loop fastener. They are not compatible with the Polaris 280 or 480, so check your model first.

A set of ten articulated figures from the Pride Lands of Disney Junior's The Lion Guard, each about 3 inches tall. The characters include Kion, Fuli, Simba, Nala, Timon, and Pumbaa, among others. Each figure is posed in an action stance and can be played with or displayed.

A lightweight tee with a humorous family slogan graphic. Its classic fit and double-needle stitching at the sleeves and hem suit everyday wear. It also works as a novelty gift for holidays, friends, or coworkers.

A one-quart yellow hydroponic plant supplement for flowering plants that supplies minerals and amino acids. It is intended to encourage abundant blooms and fruit production. It is meant to be used together with BioThrive bloom fertilizer.
A beaded napkin box with a sand dollar motif, made from recycled sandcast aluminum. It was designed by Michael Updike. The metal piece is not dishwasher safe, so clean it by other means.

A slim black leather ID badge holder with a clear front window, four card slots, a zippered coin pocket, and a cash slot. It attaches to a detachable 20-inch polyester lanyard and includes RFID blocking for higher-frequency cards. Cards with lower-frequency 125 kHz chips are not shielded.

A set of four white bath sheets measuring 31 by 63 inches and rated at 800 GSM. The cotton towels are described as absorbent and quick drying, and they keep their softness through repeated washing. They are machine washable and can go in the dryer on low heat.

A soft TPU protective case for iPhone 5, 6, 7, 8, and X models, with a design printed directly into the material. Cutouts give access to the buttons and camera lens. The image is dyed into the case itself rather than applied as a sticker or vinyl.

Footed cotton sleeper pajamas for babies in a dotted pattern, sized 18 months. The zip-up front makes them easy to put on and take off. The snug fit is noted as a sleepwear safety feature for children.

specs.care: Hand or machine wash, hang dry, no bleach

record.description: A soft short-sleeved solid white t-shirt dress for girls, suited to school, parties, or everyday wear. It runs in sizes from 3T to 13 years, so measuring your child before ordering is advised. Hand or machine wash it and hang to dry without bleach.

A classroom-sized bundle of 36 watercolor sets, made up of 12 each of basic, glitter, and metallic 8-color assortments, for 24 colors in total. Every set comes with a brush. The formula is washable, so it comes out of skin and most fabrics. The box has an easy-open lid, and the paints are AP certified non-toxic.
A lightweight vintage-style graphic tee with a humorous taco-themed slogan. It has a classic fit and double-stitched sleeves and hem. It suits casual everyday wear or as a joke gift.

A set of four capacitive styluses with a pen-style body measuring 5.5 inches long. The four styluses come in black, blue, purple, and red. Each stylus has a 4.5 mm tip on one end and a 6 mm tip on the other, and the rubber tips can be swapped out without tools. The package includes 20 extra tips.

Slip-on canvas sneakers in a leopard print with white rubber soles, made for toddlers and little kids. An elastic tongue makes them easy to pull on and off. The uppers are soft, and the sole is meant for running and playing. A toe cap adds protection.

A pack of 100 5 mm infrared emitter LEDs with a clear round lens, rated for an 850 nm wavelength. They run on about 1.4 to 1.6 volts at 20 mA and have a 2-pin lead design with the longer lead as anode. They suit IR sensors, remotes, and DIY electronics projects.

A pink plush character that unfolds into a hoodie, combining a stuffed animal with a pullover for kids ages two to ten. The hood has animal ears and the zipper pull is soft-tipped. The cotton blend is fully lined and can go in the washing machine and dryer.

A four-piece set of black porcelain drip pans, two 8-inch and two 6-inch, that catch drippings from the range element. They are designed to fit several GE, Hotpoint, and Kenmore range and cooktop models. Check the model number before ordering, and unplug the range and let it cool before swapping pans.

specs.material: Cotton, with polyester in some colors

record.description: A four-pack of men's short-sleeve tees in X-Large, in light steel and other shades. The fabric is mostly cotton, with some polyester blended in depending on the color. The cut is roomy, with double-stitched sleeves and hem and a coverseamed neck.
Arrowroot packaged as both a starch and a flour, in one 16-ounce pack from Bob's Red Mill. The listing presents it as a high-quality ingredient for the pantry.

A sleeveless floral romper with a V-neck and spaghetti straps, made from lightweight fabric with some stretch. It is sized 4XL, and its bust, waist, hip, and length measurements are listed. Wash in cold water, avoid bleach, and hang or line dry.

specs.material: Cotton rope over stainless steel wire

record.description: Two 63-inch rope perches for birds, made of colored cotton rope wrapped around steel wire. The wire can be bent into different shapes, and a small bell and hooks at each end let it attach to a cage. The rope uses food-grade pigments that birds can chew.

A roll of twenty black polyethylene trash bags measuring 46 by 60 centimeters, designed as liners for household and office bins. The bags have double-seam construction and extra thick plastic to resist tears and leaks. They can be used as stand-alone bags or as storage bags.

A rectangular 48-liter kitchen recycling bin with two inner buckets for sorting trash and recyclables side by side. Its touch bar opens the lid with an elbow, hip, or knee, and the lid stays open during food prep. The brushed stainless finish is fingerprint-proof and the lid opens evenly.

specs.media: SDXC/USB slot for JPEG and AVCHD

record.description: An entry-level Blu-ray disc player with full 1080p output that upscales 480i, 480p, and 720p video to 1080p. It starts up in about half a second and uses less power than earlier models. It includes a USB/SDXC slot for photos and AVCHD video and works with one remote for connected devices.

A black men's moccasin-style slipper with a soft felt upper and a faux shearling lining. The heel has cushioning, and the outsole is made of TPR to handle indoor and outdoor wear. The insole is semi-cemented, so it can be swapped for an orthotic. It is fully man-made.

A collapsible grip and stand for phones and tablets, in a Stony Heart design. It can prop up a device for video viewing and works with the PopSockets mount for hands-free use. It sticks best to smooth, hard phone cases and not to silicone or highly textured ones.
A three-pack of white baby diaper covers in a 0 to 6 month size. The soft, four-way stretch fabric moves with the baby. Reinforced snaps are meant to hold up over repeated use.
A men's white crew-neck tee with a distressed Union Jack graphic featuring The Rolling Stones. It is an officially licensed product in an XX-Large size.
A six-pack of ankle socks for women with shoe sizes five through nine. The design adds arch support and padding at the heel and toe, and the fabric is said to respond to body temperature.

A contemporary loveseat with an overstuffed profile and track arms in a durable performance fabric. The hardwood frame resists moisture and stains, and its down-filled cushions can be flipped and removed.

A plain white summer dress for girls with a short sleeve and a flared swinging hem. It pairs easily with jackets or cardigans for spring and fall, and the sizing has been revised based on buyer feedback.

A quiet indoor spin bike with a handlebar monitor for home workouts. The display cycles automatically through elapsed time, speed, distance, and calories, and the frame assembles with bolts and a short list of steps.
A classic slip-on canvas sneaker with a cushioned insole and a rubber sole. Stretch panels at the sides make it easy to step in and out, and the padded collar keeps the fit comfortable.

A compact action camera that records 4K video and 12-megapixel photos with a wide field of view. A remote control and phone app let you shoot from a distance, and a sealed housing takes it underwater.
A 192-piece mechanics tool set with polished chrome vanadium tools and hand stamped markings. It includes a knurled control ring and a DirectTorque mechanism for working on fasteners.
A low-cut football shoe built around a supportive frame of coated textile and synthetic panels. A mesh tongue aids airflow, a molded toe cap adds protection, and a foam sockliner cushions the foot.
Women's crew socks on a sky blue base with a repeating beagle paw print. The cotton, nylon, and spandex blend gives a snug, stretchy fit for everyday wear.
A wireless inkjet all-in-one that prints, scans, and copies for a household. Two-sided printing is automatic, and the HP Smart app walks you through setup and lets family members print from phones.
A twelve-inch team logo magnet printed on thick magnetic vinyl. It holds firmly to metal surfaces such as a car body and is meant for outdoor display.
A half-ounce bottle of nail polish from the Zoya line, sold under the shade name Hunter. The listing provides little further detail on the finish or formula, so check the bottle before buying.

specs.dimensions: 45 H x 30 W x 24 D cm

record.description: A printed black backpack with a padded laptop sleeve and a front pocket holding an internal organizer. A mesh side pocket fits most water bottles, and the base resists water.
A little-kid running shoe with a hook-and-loop strap for quick on and off. It has a breathable mesh upper, a cushioned heel, and a grooved rubber outsole for everyday wear.

specs.included: Cone washers and filter screen washer

record.description: A three-way brass T-valve that splits a toilet supply line to feed a bidet. It includes a shutoff for adjusting water pressure and a filter washer that catches sediment, and it suits American toilets.

specs.dimensions: 55 W x 23.8 D x 28 H in

record.description: A 55-inch computer desk with a powder-coated steel frame and a particle board top in an espresso finish. Two grommets help route cords, and adjustable glides keep it level on uneven floors.
A keg coupler for American D System Sankey kegs, built from 304 stainless steel for bar and restaurant use. A clicking lever engages the keg without pulling it out, and a valve vents excess pressure.

A self-balancing electric scooter with 6.5-inch wheels, UL 2272 certification, and colored LED lights. A built-in Bluetooth speaker plays music, and the board suits riders from about 44 to 220 pounds.
A handmade falsa blanket in orange, suited to yoga or lounging on a sofa. It is machine washable, and shades may vary slightly from the photo because of dye lots.

specs.contents: Two 8 oz lowball glasses, two coasters, six stones

record.description: A gift set for New Orleans Saints fans with two heavy-bottomed glasses, two sandstone coasters, and six soapstone stones that chill whiskey without diluting it. The contents rest in a solid oak box.
A navy blue vintage-style tee with an American flag print, made from a cotton blend. It is printed in the United States and suits Fourth of July wear or a patriotic gift.
A handheld rechargeable fan that sprays a fine water mist for cooling. It has three speeds, a head that rotates 180 degrees, and a neon light, and it folds for carrying on a bag.

specs.inputs: USB, AUX, TF card up to 32GB

record.description: A single-DIN car receiver with Bluetooth for hands-free calls and wireless music, plus FM radio and USB, AUX, and card inputs. It includes a remote and multicolor lighting, and the fit should be checked first.
A compact USB-C to HDMI adapter that outputs 4K video at 60Hz. Its braided nylon cable folds up for travel, and the plug is narrow enough to sit beside a standard charging cable.
A 250-foot roll of single-face corrugated cardboard, six inches wide, for wrapping fragile items. It bends around curved shapes, and its raised flutes absorb shock and resist crushing.

A self-propelled gas mower with a 170cc four-stroke engine and a 20-inch steel deck. It offers eight height settings, side discharge, mulching, and a rear bag, and its rear-wheel drive helps on rough ground.

specs.band: Comfort band for stay in place support

record.description: A wire-free everyday bra in black and nude with flexible foam cups and a comfort band. The light fabric is designed to stay nearly invisible under clothing.
A waxed canvas lunch bag with an insulated lining and a carry handle, sized for a full meal. The interior wipes clean and helps keep food warm or cold during a commute.
A plush unicorn with a soft white body and a purple mane and tail. Shimmering patterned accents decorate the hooves and horn, weighted hooves help it stand, and the surface can be wiped clean.

specs.size: Twin, 16 in deep pocket fitted sheet

record.description: A four-piece navy twin bedding set in a 500-thread-count cotton sateen weave. It includes a flat sheet, a fitted sheet with deep pockets, and two pillowcases, and it can go in the washing machine.
A cup holder phone mount with a built-in Qi wireless charger that adjusts between 5, 7.5, and 10 watts. The clamps close on their own when a phone is placed, and a button on either side opens them.
A long-sleeve toddler dress in white with an all-over fair isle print. The cotton and polyester jersey is pulled on over the head, with a crew neck and an elastic waist.

specs.dimensions: 15 L x 15 W x 18 H in

record.description: A square end table with a lower shelf and a steel tubing frame. Its brown wood-grain finish wipes clean, and at fifteen inches square it fits in small spaces such as beside a sofa.

Universal plugs and caps for cleaning and sealing glass water pipes and rigs. Two medium plugs fit either male or female joints, and a large plug is included. They also help contain odor during transport.

A right-handed golf swing trainer, 38 inches long, with a heavier head. Its training grip sets the thumb and index finger positions, and the design encourages better wrist release, tempo, and clubhead speed.

A dual-light tray that holds two flashes or lights on an underwater camera to add brightness and reduce shadows. It attaches through a standard quarter-twenty tripod mount and includes a mounting knob.
A single ear gauge plug with a clear acrylic taper and a pink glitter heart pattern. It is sold individually at twelve millimeters, so buy two for a pair. Two rubber O-rings are included.

specs.dimensions: 63 L x 23.7 W x 29.5 H in

record.description: A 63-inch writing desk with a wide work surface for computers and printers. The panel resists scratches and cleans easily, the metal frame is sturdy, and the leg height adjusts for uneven floors.
A set of six clear easels that display a teacup with its saucer standing behind, so both pieces stay visible. They suit collectors who want to show dishware on a shelf or in a curio cabinet.
Eight pairs of compression socks rated 15 to 20 mmHg, suited to travel, running, and long days on your feet. The nylon-heavy blend is breathable and absorbs moisture.

specs.material: Solid polished brass with wood handle

record.description: A vintage-style brass school bell with a wooden handle, standing twelve inches tall. It works as a functional bell and as a decorative piece for a desk or shelf.

A long-sleeve fishing shirt with built-in UPF 50 sun protection that blocks UVA and UVB rays. Its quick-drying polyester interlock pulls moisture away from the skin, and the classic fit suits outdoor trips.
A pack of ten black gel pens with a 0.38 millimeter tip. The pigment ink writes smoothly and is listed as waterproof and fade resistant, which suits note taking and marking dates on a calendar.
Fourteen black cardboard boxes with a clear window, sized for cupcakes, macarons, and cookies. Assembly is quick, and a length of jute twine is included for tying the boxes closed.
Ripped denim bib overall shorts with raw cuffed hems and adjustable metal-buckle straps. Four pockets and lightweight, slightly stretchy denim make them a casual option for warm weather.
Stud earrings with a princess-cut cubic zirconia center and a cushion-shaped halo, set in rhodium-plated sterling silver. Each pair comes in a drawstring pouch for gifting or storage.

A legal kit for drafting a will, covering how to divide assets, name beneficiaries, and appoint a guardian for minor children. Forms are downloaded after registration, and the content is state specific.

Four wooden vehicle puzzles for toddlers, showing a steamer, an airplane, a car, and a police car. Bright colors, rounded edges, and thick pieces suit small hands, and the set comes in a pouch and gift box.

A low-profile ceiling fan with an LED light and a remote control. It offers three fan speeds, adjustable color temperature, and a sleep mode with faint warm light, and suits lower ceilings and bunk beds.

A chrome flush-mount ceiling light with a crystal shade holding 143 K9 crystal balls. It measures about twelve inches square, suits hallways and entries, and accepts dimmable E26 bulbs up to 60 watts.

A halo engagement ring with a round clear cubic zirconia center stone surrounded by micro-pave accents along a sterling silver band. Rhodium plating gives it a bright finish, and the setting is nickel free and suitable for sensitive skin. Size 7, presented in a leather gift box, it suits engagements, weddings, or anniversaries.

specs.material: TPU shell with PU leather cover
specs.card slots: 3 card slots and a cash slot

record.description: A folio-style wallet case for iPhone 11, 11 Pro, and 11 Pro Max with a soft inner shell and faux leather cover. It holds a few cards and some cash, and a built-in stand props the phone up for videos or calls. Cutouts expose the buttons, camera, speaker, and charging port.

specs.hose fit: Adjustable zip for different hose diameters

record.description: A window seal for portable air conditioners and tumble dryers that fills the side gaps around an open casement or tilt window. A zip opening wraps around the exhaust hose so warm air is less likely to flow back into the room. It attaches with hook tape, needs no drilling, and can be removed when the weather cools.

An absorbent, low-profile kitchen drying mat that protects counters from water and scratches under dish racks and small appliances. The waterproof backing keeps liquids from soaking through, and the slip-resistant base holds it in place. It can be trimmed to fit with scissors and washed in a machine.

A rechargeable backup battery with a small solar panel that keeps compatible Suntek trail cameras running in the field. Overload and overdischarge protection guard the battery, and the unit mounts to a tree, pole, or tripod. It is rated IP65 for outdoor use and is compatible with several Suntek camera models.

Men's mesh athletic shorts with an open weave that allows good airflow. Dri-Power fabric pulls moisture away from the skin to help keep the wearer cool and dry. The elastic waistband has an internal drawstring for an adjustable fit, and side pockets hold small essentials.

A slim-fitting long-sleeve top in ribbed knit with a plain solid color and an asymmetrical cross-wrap neckline. The stretchy blend of polyester, cotton, and spandex suits casual wear with pants, shorts, or skirts. The seller notes the top runs small, so check the size chart before ordering.

specs.wheels: LEDs glow as the wheels spin

record.description: Clip-on heel wheels that turn ordinary shoes into roller skates for children. LEDs inside the wheels glow as they spin, so no batteries are needed. The fit is adjustable, and a rubber strap and larger brakes add safety and stopping power for kids six and older.

A thin white matte tape for drawing straight, even lines on charts, signs, and craft projects. The permanent adhesive sticks to paper, plastic, metal, glass, wood, and ceramic when the surface is clean and dry. It works indoors or outdoors. One roll is included.

A wooden toddler bed with a Nick Jr. PAW Patrol theme, recommended for children from about 15 months old. Two raised side rails help keep a young sleeper safe during the move to a big kid bed. The bed is JPMA certified and comes with simple assembly.

A pair of ivory linen-look sheer curtain panels with grommet tops for bedrooms and living rooms. The fabric lets through soft daylight and airflow while softening bright sun and adding some privacy. Each panel can be machine washed in cold water on a gentle cycle and tumble dried.

specs.use: Dry erase and magnetic bulletin board

record.description: A compact magnetic whiteboard suited to notes, lists, and simple sketches. It doubles as a bulletin board for magnets and photos, and a marker with a built-in eraser is included. The board has a slim aluminum frame and can be hung horizontally or vertically with the supplied pads.

A set of twelve reusable PEVA storage bags in sandwich, snack, and larger sizes for food and everyday items. The zip seals keep contents from leaking, and two blue sealing clips are included. Use them for freezing, snacks, or portioned meals, but keep them away from microwaves, ovens, and dishwashers.

A seven-pack of long-sleeve bodysuits for baby girls in assorted styles, sized for 18 months. The strong snaps are built to stand up to frequent washing and wear. A practical everyday layering basic for a baby's wardrobe.

specs.main ingredients: Plant proteins, amino acids, plant ceramides

record.description: A vanilla plant-based protein powder marketed to support collagen production, skin hydration, and joint support. It combines plant proteins with amino acids, plant ceramides, and a white tea extract. The formula is free of dairy, gluten, soy, and common allergens, and it can be mixed into shakes or coffee.

Six refill bulbs for Wallflower fragrance plugs and night-lights, in a warm pumpkin scent blended with sweet butter and vanilla cream. They arrive as three twin-packs. The listing notes that this fragrance has been discontinued and is hard to find.

A mixed box of packaged snacks made in several Eastern European countries, typically including candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, and pretzels. Each box holds at least eight items, and the exact mix varies from box to box. The photos show examples of the kinds of snacks you may receive.

specs.fit: Manual and automatic shifters without a button

record.description: A black skull-shaped gear shift knob made of resin and aluminum alloy. Three rubber adapters let it fit shifter rods of different diameters, and a hex spanner and screws are included for installation. It is intended for shifters without a button and is not suited to reverse-lock pull-up shifters.

Ivory faux plastic pearls with no holes, sold in a 200-piece kit with six packets of water gel that make the pearls float. They work as vase fillers, table scatter, or decoration for weddings, showers, and other events. The pearls can be reused, and the gel is described as nontoxic and biodegradable.

specs.includes: Bassinet stroller and infant car seat
specs.seat cleaning: Spot clean with mild soap and water

record.description: A travel system pairing a bassinet-style stroller with the SnugRide SnugLock 35 infant car seat. The stroller reclines into a bassinet and converts to a toddler seat that can face either direction. The car seat clicks directly onto the stroller frame, and the seat pad can be spot cleaned.

A white plastic tray sized for 24-inch flower boxes, designed to protect decks, patios, or indoor surfaces beneath them. The lightweight, fade-resistant construction is made in the USA. The flower box itself is not included, so only the tray comes in the package.

specs.fit: Snug arms for standard cabinet shelves

record.description: A medium steel wire basket with snug arms that fit over a cabinet shelf, creating a second storage level underneath. It suits spices, napkins, small boxes, and utensils. The coated frame resists rust, and hooks for attaching it to other surfaces are sold separately.

A small heart-shaped locket with 24-karat gold plating that holds two photos. It can be purchased with or without an 18-inch curb chain and arrives in a black velvet pouch. The maker offers a lifetime replacement guarantee if the locket breaks, tarnishes, or fades.

A compact brass fountain pen with a fine gold-plated steel nib. It is made by hand in Nuremberg with individual quality checks and is light enough to carry in a pocket. The pen writes with a soft, smooth feel.

Pre-fanned volume eyelash extensions designed for technicians who are new to hand volume work. A sticky base strip keeps each fan from separating while it is being formed. The lashes come in several colors and length mixes and suit professional salons and training programs.

A wall-mounted coat rack made of distressed wood with five metal hooks for coats, hats, bags, and keys. It measures 24 by 4.5 inches and holds up to 30 pounds. Mounting hardware is included, and the rack suits entryways, kitchens, or bedrooms.

specs.capacity: 200 lb or more when installed properly
specs.use: Fishing, hunting, and chest waders, wader boots

record.description: A stainless steel chain hanger for drying fishing waders, hunting waders, and wader boots. The chain design helps waders keep their natural shape during storage. Hanging them off the ground lets them dry faster and can extend their service life.

specs.exterior: Bonded fleece with grid knit texture

record.description: A men's full-zip jacket with a bonded fleece exterior in a grid knit texture and a cozy sherpa lining. Two side zip pockets hold small items, and a Spyder logo is embroidered on the front. It works as a warm mid layer over a shirt or under a shell in cold weather.

A pet staircase that helps dogs reach couches and higher beds. Each step has a slight incline, which reduces the number of steps needed to climb. The carpeted tread is removable for cleaning, and the stair is designed for dogs of all sizes.

specs.functions: Black and red ballpoint, 0.5 mm pencil, stylus, eraser

record.description: A satin black multifunction pen that switches between black and red ballpoint refills and a 0.5 mm pencil. It has a stylus and a hidden eraser, and the chrome-accented barrel can be engraved with a name or short message of up to 25 characters. The pen carries a lifetime mechanical warranty.

A black short-sleeve cotton t-shirt printed with a Raiders football fan slogan. The screen print is applied in the USA, and the shirt is pre-shrunk for a stable fit. It can be machine washed and is offered in sizes from small to 5X.

A kids' sandal with a vegan leather strap lined in jersey so it sits comfortably on the foot. The soft EVA footbed includes arch support, and the molded outsole provides grip in several directions. The triple density EVA construction is built to flex with the foot.

A white short-sleeve kids' jersey for Real Madrid fans, with a crewneck and a regular fit slightly looser than the players' cut. It is made from recycled polyester with sweat-wicking fabric and mesh panels under the arms. A woven Real Madrid crest is part of the design.

An HDTV video cable for the Saturn game console that supports 720p resolution with clear picture and crisp audio. The main cable is seven feet long and a six-foot micro cable is included. It works with HDTVs and every Saturn model.

specs.fits: Oakley Holbrook frames, model OO9102 series

record.description: Replacement polarized lenses for Oakley Holbrook sunglass frames with model numbers starting OO9102. The dark silver mirror coating sits over a grey base, and the lenses are 1.4 mm thick for impact resistance. They are not made by Oakley and do not include a frame.

specs.upper: Fabric straps with nubuck toe post
specs.footbed: Molded EVA with arch support and heel cup

record.description: A women's thong sandal with fabric straps and a soft nubuck toe post. The molded, quick-drying EVA footbed includes arch support, a heel cup, and a toe bar. The shock-absorbing midsole and flexible rubber outsole are suited to beach and poolside use.

A jumbo pet bowl with a rubber base that grips slick floors and resists sliding. Its heavy construction limits movement on tile and linoleum. The bowl is dishwasher safe and suited to extra large breed dogs. Colors vary by unit.

An unframed, officially licensed LEGO Batman grid poster printed on FSC-certified gloss paper. It measures about 22 by 34 inches and can be framed or hung with clips, pins, or poster mounts. It suits a bedroom, playroom, office, or dorm.

A three-pack of sleeveless toddler tank tops in blue stripe, orange gator, and gray stripe patterns. Each tank has a ribbed neckline and a small pocket detail. The set comes in packaging without hang tags.

A double-wall kraft corrugated bottom for large gaylord boxes, measuring 48 by 40 by 36 inches. It consolidates multi-piece shipments and protects bulky or irregularly shaped items. Sold in a pack of 75 and shipped flat, it works with the matching gaylord lid.

specs.charging: External USB port with built-in cable

record.description: A small black crossbody sling bag in water-resistant PU leather with adjustable nylon straps. It has two main compartments, a front zip pocket, and an anti-theft pocket, and it holds a small tablet and a phone. The external USB port includes a built-in cable, but a power bank is not included.

specs.packaging: Fitted gift box with enclosure card

record.description: A hand-painted resin figurine of a grandmother in a cream dress seated on a gray bench, holding hands with a young girl. It is cast from an original carving by artist Susan Lordi and is meant to celebrate the bond between grandparent and child. It can stand alone or join other figures in a family grouping.

A heavy-duty stainless steel multitool with 21 tools, including replaceable wire cutters and spring-action scissors. Four outside-opening blades give quick access, and the locks make it safe to use one-handed. It comes with a nylon sheath and lanyard ring and carries a 25-year warranty.

specs.hat: Matching chef hat with hook-and-loop fastener

record.description: A short-sleeve, double-breasted chef jacket for women in white, sold with a matching chef hat. The jacket has ten buttons and can be worn with either side as the front. The hat fits a range of sizes thanks to its hook-and-loop closure, and sizing should follow the bust measurement.

specs.care: Hand wash in cool water, dry out of sun

record.description: Three-millimeter neoprene gloves for snorkeling, kayaking, surfing, and other water sports. The stretchy, form-fitting material is combined with a textured palm for grip, and a velcro strap at the wrist helps keep sand out. The gloves are not fully waterproof and are meant to be worn with a wetsuit.

Cuffed denim shortalls for juniors with several pockets, a center front zipper, and adjustable straps. The fabric includes LYCRA for stretch, and the legs finish in a 3-inch cuff. Machine wash cold and tumble dry on low.

A space gray aluminum USB-C hub that adds four USB 3.0 ports to a laptop. Data transfers reach up to 5 Gbps, and the USB-C port passes up to 60 watts to a compatible laptop while powering attached accessories. It works plug and play without an external driver and is compatible with many laptop models.

An 18 by 24 inch museum quality poster reproducing the Oversoul artwork by Alex Grey. The listing presents it as an official item. The product notes say human consciousness is a bridge between planetary and cosmic consciousness.

A folding rocking chair with a powder-coated steel frame and breathable TechMesh seat. A low-profile rocker locks into place for safe rocking. It folds compactly and comes with a shoulder bag for carrying and storage. The chair weighs about 11 pounds and supports up to 300 pounds.

A pair of size D batteries themed after the Good Guys doll from the film Child's Play 2, produced under license. They are presented as a collectible accessory for a Good Guy doll. The design is based on onscreen and behind-the-scenes images from the film.
